title: مسودة إيثريوم: الراعي يدفع للدفعة وأنت تدفع لكل مطالبة
subTitle:

من يدفع ماذا؟
الراعي يمكنه تمويل الدفعة، بينما يدفع الأعضاء لكل مطالبة. هذا يخالف فكرة رسم جماعي واحد.

هل الرسوم مؤكدة؟
لا. الرسوم والتفعيل مرتبطان باختبارات الأداء، والمسودة ليست تنفيذاً نهائياً.

ماذا يعني لك؟
إذا كنت ضمن دفعة إثبات، فقد تحتاج لحساب تكلفة كل مطالبة بدل تكلفة جماعية. وإذا تأخر اختبار الأداء، فقد يتأخر أي تفعيل.

الخلاصة: السؤال هنا ليس كم تدفع الدفعة، بل كم تدفع أنت عند كل مطالبة.

translatedData.subTitle:
The first reading of this draft is that it involves sharing the costs of the batch, but the details say the sponsor may fund the batch while you pay $ETH for each claim.

Who pays for what?
The sponsor can fund the batch, while members pay for each claim. This contradicts the idea of a single shared fee.

Are the fees confirmed?
No. The fees and activation are tied to performance tests, and the draft is not a final implementation.

If the code is changed after an audit, or the version actually deployed differs from the audited version, the audit findings may no longer apply.
One thing that's easy to overlook: risks don't come only from contract code. Oracles, other protocols it depends on, admin permissions, and hijacked front ends can all lead to losses.
In DeFi, only put in funds you can afford to lose, and it's best to spread large amounts across different protocols.
Ethereum, where $ETH  is located, is one of the earliest public blockchains to support general-purpose smart contracts.

📰 Miners just said things were stabilizing, and now Bitcoin suddenly turns negative

Just a couple of days ago, we talked about major companies increasing their Bitcoin holdings. Now Michael Saylor’s Strategy fund has gone straight from being in the black to being in the red, as Bitcoin’s price fell below 67K. This is the first time the world’s largest corporate Bitcoin holder has had unrealized losses, which could subtly affect market sentiment.

Why is this news important?
The root cause isn’t a misjudgment by the Strategy fund, but Bitcoin’s own cyclical adjustment. JPMorgan’s and BlackRock’s ETF increases in holdings were both driven by institutional allocation needs. But now that Bitcoin has fallen below 67K, the Strategy fund has been forced to recognize losses, showing that pressure on institutional holdings has reached the cost basis. This means the market may not have bottomed out yet, since the largest corporate holder is now sitting on unrealized losses.

Impact on the market
The main impact on BTC is psychological. In the short term, it could intensify selling pressure, as large investors who bought at higher prices are now starting to show losses on paper. In the long term, if Bitcoin continues to fall, more companies may write down their holdings. Historically, every major Bitcoin correction has created a window for institutions to rebuild their positions, and this time is no different.

💡 The Strategy fund’s unrealized losses may make other companies more cautious. They probably won’t significantly increase their holdings for now, but they also won’t reduce them in a panic. If Bitcoin can stabilize around 68K, it may trigger some capital to flow back in. If it continues to fall below 65K, this cautious stance may shift to an even more conservative one.

【The assessment includes invalidation conditions】If Bitcoin falls below 65K and stays there for two weeks, the Strategy fund’s cautious stance may turn into a full-scale reduction of its holdings, invalidating this assessment.

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep Posted Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Exactly as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget all the principles, so I wrote them down and stuck them up where I can see them:

One. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
Two. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
Three. Never add to a losing position or average down.
Four. After three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
Five. Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is yours; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

Just five rules, and not one of them is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution broke down. Let’s keep each other accountable.

title: 关注动态短报｜周六晚间：67k 破了，先记账别把低点和联名信写成定论
subTitle:
来源：@timestampDAO 关注时间线（今日 08:00 → 18:00，新加坡时间）｜信息分享，非投资建议。

【晚间补记】发帖时币安现货大约：BTC 约 67277（24 小时约 −3.1%，高点约 70214，低点约 66456），ETH 约 1909（约 −2.4%，低约 1878），SOL 约 75.8（约 −5.8%，低约 74.9）。白天已跌破 67,000、低见约 66,400 一带，傍晚这截反抽仍在 67,200 附近。先记账，别把低点写成底部已经确认，也别把股东联名信写成交接已经翻篇。

一、重点话题

1. 股东联名信：要求保留黄仁勋回归等选项

Altimeter 的 Brad Gerstner 与 Atreides 的 Gavin Baker 联名致信英伟达董事会，要求慎重处理、保留包括让 Jensen 回归在内的所有选项。Altimeter 称英伟达是其第一大持仓（约 941 万股、市值近 19 亿美元，约占组合 20%）。独立网站「Stand with Jensen」截至北京时间 12:56 显示约 46,864 人签名（公开名单中有马斯克、何一、Garry Tan 等；网站不做身份核验，名单里已出现冒名与恶搞）。马斯克还暗示，董事会部分成员履历不佳，不像懂 AI 和显卡。联名信和请愿都是股东与外界的态度，不是新的公司公告，不要写成回归已经敲定，或「AI 交易已经结束」。

2. 比特币白天跌破 67,000，低见约 66,400

CoinGecko 称比特币跌破 67,000 美元，近一周约下跌 12%；有人梳理记低点约 6.64 万美元、30 日约 −18%，Ahr999 降至 0.34 重回低估区，但抄底窗口本轮才刚开一周，并不等于底部已确认。KillaXBT 只给出两种情景：底从未确认、还要创新低，或这是一次很狠的 23% 清洗；blknoiz06 对几乎没有反弹表示难以置信。傍晚蒋卓尔追问：周线六连跌、又连续跌破短期持有者成本、200 日线和 50 周线之后，牛市是否还在、会否跌破 57,800。这些是他人框架和提问，先记下，不是这里的操作结论。不要把跌破 67,000 自动写成底部已经走完，也不要把 57,800 写成下一步已经发生。

3. ETH 链上一边在买、一边在卖

Lookonchain 记 ShapeShift 创始人 Erik Voorhees 用 475 万 USDT 在约 1,896 美元买入 2,504 枚 ETH；「7 Siblings」再买 9,766 枚（约 1,888 万美元，均价约 1,933 美元）；地址 58bro.eth 近两日以约 1,978 美元均价买回 10,501 枚。另一边，以太坊基金会关联钱包一小时内再卖 1,000 枚，近 5 日累计卖出 5,000 枚（均价约 1,983.5 美元）。另有「铁头」多军九个地址合计约 1.55 亿美元多单（含约 6.08 万枚 ETH 和 600 枚 BTC），浮亏约 4,406 万美元。买卖并列，先记账，不要写成单边结论。

4. 币安：本周已重开 87 条网络提现，力争下周末前恢复全部

官方公告称本周已重新开放 87 条网络的提现，并争取在下周末前恢复所有剩余网络和资产；吴说补充包括 APT、HYPE、LTC、NEAR、ADA、AVAX 等，恢复期间流量较大，部分提现可能延迟。

5. Pump.fun 继续出货 SOL

Lookonchain 称 Pump.fun 约 7 小时前再向 Kraken 存入 64,666 枚 SOL（约 519 万美元），累计已卖出 5,618,499 枚（约 8.876 亿美元，均价约 158 美元）。也有人观察到，比特币触及 66,000 上方时，部分山寨（如 PUMP）波动并不大，认为山寨流动性正在被抽干。

另有高热但偏氛围：马斯克持续更新 Starship Flight 15，称飞船正以约 90 分钟绕地一圈，后续航班计划携带超过 50 Tb/s 的 Starlink 带宽；Cursor 发布了近期安全事件的详情与修复说明。

二、多人提及（符号）

- BTC — 白天跌破 67,000，低见约 66,400，近一周约 −12%

Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly keep their money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days a year adds up to 12 times your money; at a steady 10% a month,
you’ll have 30 times your money after three years. It may not sound exciting, but it has one magical quality—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities must be waited for; discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “doubling your money this week.” Set it as “making no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former comes from the market,
while the ability behind the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

Morgan Stanley ETH Trust Disclosure｜About 70% Staked｜I’ll Reassess the Bullish Case Based on Liquidity

My stance is neutral to cautious. The quarterly report for the Morgan Stanley Ethereum Trust, signed and filed with the U.S. SEC on November 13, offers a more specific perspective than simply saying “institutions are bullish on ETH”: as of September 30, 70% of the ETH held by the trust had been staked; from the start of operations on July 27 through September 30, the average staking ratio was about 69.95%. The report also states that under normal market conditions, the manager intends to stake 50% to 80% of the trust’s ETH, but may adjust that amount based on redemption needs, regulatory requirements, client vulnerabilities, and service-provider risks. This is the arrangement for this trust; it should not be extrapolated to mean that all ETFs stake their holdings, nor does it mean that 70% of the ETH was newly purchased on November 14.

The financial figures should also be viewed separately. For the period above, the trust earned approximately $35,098 in net staking rewards, incurred about $9,050 in management fees, and had net investment income of roughly $26,048. The report says that the net asset value per share rose 38.51% over the same period, while the ETH benchmark price rose 38.41%. The difference of about 0.10 percentage points was related to net staking income offsetting expenses. But ETH prices rose during this period, so the NAV performance was still driven primarily by the coin’s price. The 38.51% gain should not be interpreted as a staking yield. Staking rewards are a modest increment earned while holding the asset; they cannot shield investors from price declines or liquidity risks during redemptions.

In terms of mechanics, when institutions hold ETH through a trust and stake it, some of those holdings may temporarily leave the immediately sellable supply. But share creations and redemptions, unstaking timelines, and cash distributions can all change that structure. The report says the trust intends to distribute net staking rewards monthly, at least quarterly, and may sell an equivalent amount of ETH to raise cash. This detail is a reminder that staking does not mean assets are permanently locked up, and institutional holdings do not necessarily represent one-way buying pressure. Farside’s U.S. spot ETH ETF flow table for November 13 showed total net inflows of only about $2.3 million, with approximately $11.6 million flowing into FETH and about $9.3 million flowing out of another product, ETH. The overall total was close to flat, so historical staking data from a single trust cannot be used to declare that capital has returned to the market as a whole.

According to Binance’s publicly available ETH/USDT 24-hour market data, the latest price is about $1,914, with a low of roughly $1,878 and a high of about $1,989; the price is still down approximately 1.36% over 24 hours. The volatility cannot be directly attributed to this report, and the market has not shown a strong breakout. I see $1,878 as short-term support and the $1,989–$2,000 range as the zone where a rebound needs confirmation. If the price breaks below $1,878 and then rebounds weakly, my view that it is stabilizing would be invalidated. If inflows remain positive and the price moves above $2,000 and holds that level on a retest, I would give the bullish case more weight. Quarterly data and real-time market prices should not be conflated.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. The only direction I would consider is a long position in unleveraged spot, with my position size at 0. I would only use 3% of my account funds to take a trial position if ETH/USDT breaks above $2,000 and holds on a retest, while ETF net inflows remain positive on the next trading day. I would take half off at the first target of $2,050, reduce most of the remainder at the second target of $2,120, and let the rest run with a trailing stop. After entry, I would exit at a stop loss if the price falls back below $1,950. If it first breaks below $1,878, I would cancel the plan and remain in cash. If the trust or regulators issue new documents that change the staking arrangements, I would review them again rather than treating an old report as a real-time commitment. This is a conditional plan; it does not mean a trade has been executed or a profit made.

Sources: SEC quarterly report, Farside U.S. ETH ETF flow table, and publicly available Binance ETH/USDT market data.

#ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

摩根士丹利ETH信托披露｜质押比例约70%｜我看流动性再谈多头

我的态度是中性偏谨慎。11月13日签署、提交给美国SEC的Morgan Stanley Ethereum Trust季度报告，提供了一个比“机构看好ETH”更具体的观察角度：截至9月30日，信托持有的ETH中有70%已用于质押；从7月27日开始运营到9月30日，平均质押比例约69.95%。报告还写明，正常市场条件下，管理方打算质押信托ETH的50%至80%，但会因赎回需求、监管、客户端漏洞和服务商风险调整。这是该信托的安排，不能外推成所有ETF均质押，也不是11月14日刚刚新买入70%的ETH。

财务数字也应拆开看。该信托上述期间的净质押奖励约35098美元，管理费约9050美元，净投资收益约26048美元。报告称每份净值同期上涨38.51%，ETH基准价格上涨38.41%，差额约0.10个百分点与净质押收益抵扣费用有关。但这段期间恰好ETH价格上行，净值表现主要仍由币价驱动，不能把38.51%的涨幅解释成质押收益率。质押收益是持币期间的小幅增量，不能替投资者消除价格下跌或赎回时的流动性风险。

机制上，机构通过信托持有ETH并质押，可能使一部分持仓暂时离开即时可售供给；但份额申赎、解押时间和现金分配又会改变这个结构。报告说信托拟按月、至少按季度分配净质押奖励，并可能卖出等值ETH筹集现金。这个细节提醒我：质押不等于永久锁仓，机构持有也不等于单向买盘。Farside的11月13日美国ETH现货ETF表显示合计仅净流入约230万美元，FETH流入约1160万美元，另一产品ETH流出约930万美元。总量接近持平，不能拿单一信托的历史质押数据宣布全市场资金已回流。

查询币安ETH/USDT公开24小时行情，最新约1914美元，区间低点约1878、高点约1989，24小时仍跌约1.36%。波动不能直接归因于这份报告，也未呈现强势突破。我把1878美元看作短线防守位，1989至2000美元看作反弹确认区。若跌破1878后反抽无力，企稳判断被推翻；若资金流持续转正且价格站上2000并回踩守住，才提高看多权重。季度数据与实时行情不能混为一谈。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向只考虑无杠杆现货多头，仓位为0。只有ETH/USDT突破2000美元并回踩守住，同时下一交易日ETF净流入仍为正，我才用账户资金的3%试仓；第一目标2050美元减半，第二目标2120美元再减大部分，剩余部分随趋势止盈。入场后跌回1950美元以下止损平仓；若先跌破1878美元，取消计划继续空仓。若信托或监管发布改变质押安排的新文件，也要重新核对，不把旧报告当作今天的实时承诺。这是条件计划，并无已成交或盈利的意思。

U.S. Spot Crypto ETFs See $1.48 Billion in Net Outflows Over Five Days

U.S. spot crypto ETFs recorded a combined net outflow of $1.48 billion over the five trading days from November 4 to 10, indicating a recent shift toward caution among investors allocating to crypto assets through regulated products. Over the same period, the 10 largest U.S. equity ETFs attracted a combined $37.5 billion, highlighting a stark contrast in flows between traditional equity funds and crypto funds.

By asset, Bitcoin funds saw $1.06 billion in net outflows, accounting for the bulk of withdrawals in this period. Ethereum funds saw $326 million in outflows, while related funds for SOL, XRP, HYPE, and ZEC collectively saw $89.4 million in outflows. A separate tally showed Bitcoin ETFs recording outflows of about $1.44 billion over five consecutive trading days, with the largest single-day withdrawals concentrated in major Bitcoin ETFs; Ethereum ETFs saw about $523.4 million in redemptions over five days. The two sets of figures cover different scopes, but both point to continued pressure on mainstream crypto ETFs.

It is worth noting that ETF net outflows do not mean all holders are selling their positions, nor can they be taken as direct evidence of a one-way shift in crypto asset fundamentals. ETF flow data reflects the net amount after subscriptions and redemptions, and may be affected by risk appetite, portfolio rebalancing, macroeconomic expectations, and shifts in holdings between products. Some reports have noted that certain large holders use in-kind conversions to move self-custodied assets into ETF structures; these transactions change the custody method, but do not necessarily represent new buying in the public market.

For crypto markets, ETFs are an important channel connecting traditional capital with spot demand. When redemptions continue, new allocations in the primary market weaken, while market-making, arbitrage, and institutional risk management activity may further amplify short-term volatility. When Bitcoin and Ethereum funds see outflows at the same time, markets tend to be more sensitive in their risk pricing of mainstream assets. Meanwhile, smaller asset ETFs have lower assets under management, so the significance of their flows as a sentiment indicator should be assessed in light of the products' existing holdings.

The editorial view is that the most noteworthy aspect of this round of data is not the outflow figure alone, but the simultaneous redemptions from crypto funds and inflows into equity ETFs. This suggests that some investors are favoring traditional equities amid volatility. To determine whether institutional appetite for allocations is recovering, it will be important to monitor whether net flows shift from sporadic inflows to more sustained improvement, and to consider differences across asset classes and issuers rather than drawing conclusions from a single day's data.

美国现货加密ETF五日净流出14.8亿美元

美国现货加密ETF在11月4日至10日的五个交易日内合计净流出14.8亿美元，显示通过受监管产品配置加密资产的资金近期明显转向谨慎。同期，10只主要美国股票ETF合计吸引375亿美元，传统股票基金与加密基金之间形成鲜明的资金流向反差。

从结构看，比特币基金净流出10.6亿美元，是本轮撤出资金的主要部分；以太坊基金流出3.26亿美元，SOL、XRP、HYPE和ZEC等相关基金合计流出8940万美元。另一份统计显示，比特币ETF连续五个交易日流出约14.4亿美元，其中单日资金撤出较多的产品集中于大型比特币ETF；以太坊ETF五日赎回约5.234亿美元。两组数据统计范围不同，但均指向主流加密ETF持续承压。

需要注意的是，ETF净流出不等同于所有持有者都在清仓，也不能直接解释为加密资产基本面发生单向变化。ETF资金数据反映的是申购和赎回后的净额，可能同时受风险偏好、组合再平衡、宏观预期以及产品间持仓迁移影响。有报道提及，部分大额持有人会通过实物转换把自主托管资产转入ETF结构；这类操作改变托管方式，却未必对应新增公开市场买盘。

对加密市场而言，ETF是连接传统资金与现货需求的重要渠道。当连续赎回发生时，一级市场新增配置减弱，做市、套利和机构风险管理行为可能进一步放大短期波动。尤其当比特币与以太坊基金同步流出时，市场对主流资产的风险定价往往更敏感；而小型资产ETF规模较小，资金变动对情绪的指示意义需结合产品存量观察。

编辑判断是，本轮数据更值得关注的并非单一流出数字，而是加密基金赎回与股票ETF吸金同时出现。这说明部分资金在波动环境中优先选择了传统权益资产。后续若要判断机构配置意愿是否修复，应持续观察净流向能否由零星流入转为更具连续性的改善，并结合不同资产类别和不同发行商的分化，而非仅凭某一天的数据下结论。

title: SanDisk Tokenized bStocks (SNDKB) Market Breakdown: Technicals, Fundamentals & The Big 8-for-1 Split
subTitle:
Real-World Assets (RWAs) are quietly bridging the gap between Wall Street and Web3, and SanDisk Tokenized bStocks (SNDKB) is right in the middle of the action. Trading around $863 – $865, SNDKB has been navigating a heavy cooldown from its June 2026 highs, while preparing for a major structural catalyst just days away.
The Technical Picture: Finding a Floor After a Steep Drawdown
Looking at the broader chart structure, SNDKB has gone through an aggressive correction over the past few months, sitting roughly 63.5% below its all-time high of ~$2,369. However, recent price action suggests sellers might finally be running out of steam:
Support & Accumulation Zone: The market carved out a solid local bottom near $798 on November 8–9. Since bouncing off that level, price has been consolidating in the $850 – $945 range, showing resilience even while the broader crypto and RWA markets bled lower over the past week.
Momentum & Trend: Daily moving averages and higher-timeframe indicators still lean bearish following the multi-month downtrend (-44% over the past 30 days). On shorter intraday frames, momentum has shifted to neutral as buyers defend the mid-$800s.
Key Levels to Watch:
Support: $850 (intraday floor) and $798 (major macro support). Losing $798 opens the door to fresh price discovery on the downside.
Resistance: $905 – $945 (immediate supply zone), followed by the psychological $1,000 mark. A clean breakout above $950 with rising volume would confirm a short-term trend reversal.
The Fundamentals: 24/7 Wall Street Exposure + A Major Catalyst
Unlike speculative meme coins or pure governance tokens, SNDKB is a regulated tokenized equity. Issued via the bStocks platform on the BNB Smart Chain (BEP-20), each token is backed 1:1 by actual shares of SanDisk Corporation (SNDK) held with a US-regulated broker-dealer.
Why Traders Use It: Holders get direct exposure to SanDisk's stock price movements, automated dividend reinvestments, and the ability to trade 24/7—even when traditional stock markets are closed for the weekend. Because it lives on-chain, it can also be self-custodied or plugged into BNB Chain DeFi protocols.
Market Footprint: With a market cap hovering around $76M – $97M and daily trading volumes regularly exceeding $44M – $57M (led heavily by Binance's SNDKB/USDT pair), liquidity remains healthy for active spot and swing traders.
Upcoming Catalyst: The 8-for-1 Stock Split (Nov 18–20)
The biggest headline for SNDKB right now is Binance's official support for SanDisk's 8-for-1 forward stock split:
How It Works: For every 1 SNDKB held, users will receive 7 additional tokens (8 total), and the unit price will adjust to roughly one-eighth of its pre-split value. While total portfolio value stays the same, a lower per-unit price (dropping from ~$860 to ~$108) often sparks fresh retail interest and improved liquidity.
Critical Dates: Margin loans close on November 18 (15:00 UTC), and Spot trading/deposits pause briefly on November 20 (00:30 UTC) before resuming later that morning.
Final Take
SNDKB is sitting at a classic inflection point. Technically, it is trying to build a base above $800 after a bruising multi-month pullback. Fundamentally, the upcoming 8-for-1 split brings genuine structural excitement and makes the token far more accessible to smaller retail buyers. Keep a close eye on how price reacts around the $850 – $900 zone heading into the November 20 suspension window—volatility is almost guaranteed.
Disclaimer: This post is for informational and educational purposes only and should not be taken as financial advice. Always manage your risk, especially around scheduled exchange suspensions and corporate split events.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Your Brain Is Lying to You When You Hold on to a Losing Trade
translatedData.subTitle:
What does someone down 50% on a trade focus on? The all-time high. They tell themselves, “Once it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Pay attention: that thought is all attachment, no logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price,
it only responds to current supply and demand.

After you start holding a losing trade, you automatically seek out bullish news and filter out bearish news. This is called confirmation bias. You start to think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple, but hard to follow: before entering a trade, write down “what would invalidate the logic behind this trade,”
and act when that point is reached, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decisions from your positions, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

translatedData.content:
ETF redemptions are a slow variable, while leveraged unrealized losses are a fast variable; their mechanisms affecting BTC price are not the same. My observation is: during a phase of continued net outflows from ETF funds, unrealized losses on leveraged long positions are more likely to amplify short-term volatility, but they do not in themselves determine the trend; the key is whether both pressures persist at the same time.

First, the facts. According to Cointelegraph, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw net outflows of $185.4 million on Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million of that and posting negative flows for 11 consecutive trading days; the report said total net outflows over the past two weeks reached $2.35 billion. This is capital movement as disclosed by issuers. On the other hand, PANews cited monitoring by Ai Yi, saying that nine addresses associated with a bit-linked entity hold about $155 million in long positions, including 60,841.22 ETH and 600 BTC, with an unrealized loss of $44.06 million, excluding funding fees. This is an on-chain observation from a single source, and the loss is unrealized, changing with price fluctuations.

Based on this, ETF outflows affect price through spot absorption: redemptions mean shares are sold back and the fund must dispose of spot holdings accordingly, weakening marginal buying demand. Unrealized losses on long positions take a different path—they do not directly sell coins, but they squeeze margin buffers; if prices fall further, they may trigger de-risking or liquidations, creating passive selling pressure. The former is slow and predictable; the latter is fast and nonlinear. When the two combine, volatility is amplified; when only one is present, the impact is relatively manageable.

The conditions under which this judgment would fail are also clear: if IBIT’s consecutive net outflows are interrupted and turn into net inflows, spot absorption improves and the slow-variable pressure eases; if the above long-position addresses actively reduce positions or add margin, the fast-variable risk declines. The source material does not provide these addresses’ liquidation levels, margin ratios, or funding fee details, so their degree of stress cannot be quantified. That is a gap that still needs verification.

My observation is that two indicators are worth tracking next: the continuity of IBIT’s daily net outflows, and the position changes of those long-position addresses. The former verifies the funding side, the latter verifies the leverage side. This article does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETF赎回是慢变量，杠杆浮亏是快变量，两者对BTC价格的作用机制并不相同。我的观察是：在ETF资金持续净流出的阶段，杠杆多单的浮亏更容易放大短期波动，但它本身不构成趋势判断，关键要看两股压力是否同时持续。

先看事实。据Cointelegraph报道，美国现货比特币ETF周五净流出1.854亿美元，其中贝莱德IBIT流出1.435亿美元，连续11个交易日为负；报道称两周合计净流出23.5亿美元。这是发行商披露口径下已发生的资金变动。另一面，PANews援引Ai姨监测称，bit关联实体九个地址持有约1.55亿美元多单，含60841.22枚ETH和600枚BTC，浮亏4406万美元，未计入资金费。这是单一来源的链上观察，浮亏属未实现，随价格波动。

据此推断，ETF流出通过现货承接力影响价格：赎回意味着份额被卖回、基金需相应处置现货，边际买盘减弱。而多单浮亏走的是另一条路——它不直接卖币，却压缩保证金缓冲，价格再跌可能触发减仓或强平，形成被动卖压。前者慢、可预期；后者快、非线性。两者叠加时，波动被放大；只有一方时，冲击相对可控。

判断失效的条件也清楚：若IBIT连续净流出中断、转为净流入，现货承接改善，慢变量压力缓解；若上述多单地址主动减仓或补足保证金，快变量风险下降。本次素材未提供这些地址的强平线、保证金率和资金费明细，无法量化其承压程度，这是待验证的缺口。

我的观察是，接下来值得跟踪两个指标：IBIT每日净流出的连续性，以及该多单地址的仓位变化。前者验证资金面，后者验证杠杆面。本文不构成投资建议。

title: 周六傍晚：早盘还在约 6.83 万盯周五约 6.76 会不会再踩——10 点刚过一脚砸穿，中午最低到了约 6.65
subTitle:
公开行情里，早盘那篇还在约 6.83 万，盯着周五下午约 6.76 的坑还要不要再踩，夜里摸到的约 7.02 已经在上头。9 点这截其实还贴着走，最高约 6.84，几乎没离开早盘位置。结果 10 点 15 分一下子从约 6.82 削到约 6.69，周五约 6.76 直接被砸穿；11 点半到 12 点再往下挖，中午最低约 6.65。下午反抽最远摸到约 6.75（15 点那根），连刚破掉的周五低点约 6.76 都没收回来，随后又吐回到约 6.70 一带。这会儿 BTC 约 6.70 万（近 24 小时约 -2.5%），从早盘约 6.83 又滑了约 1300；从夜里约 7.02 算，已经滑了约 3200。ETH 约 1895（约 -1.9%），白天最低约 1878，把周五下午约 1896 也踩穿了，下午反抽最高才约 1911；BNB 约 614（约 -2.7%），低点约 613；SOL 约 75.3（约 -5.6%）还是最软的一截，白天最低约 74.9，早盘约 77.2 的低点也没守住；XRP 早盘还在约 1.008、跌幅最浅，这会儿约 0.984（约 -4.2%），下午最低约 0.98，约 1 块没守住。

周六傍晚这个位置，我不把「从约 6.65 抬回约 6.70」读成下午已经把这腿走完了：更刺眼的是，早盘还在问的周五约 6.76，白天不仅踩实，还往下挖到约 6.65，下午反抽最高才约 6.75，连刚破掉的那根低点都摸不回去。约 6.76、约 6.83、约 6.94、约 7 万，这会儿都还在上头。

结构上我更盯三件事：一是约 6.70、白天低点约 6.65 这截还站不站得住——若再往下靠近约 6.65，说明下午这截只是破位后的回抽；二是约 6.76、约 6.83 还收不收得回来，收不回来就还是在周五低点下方走；三是 ETH 约 1878 / 约 1900，以及 XRP 约 1 块失守之后，SOL 约 74.9 还止不住。

BitMine’s losses top the trending list | $6.3 billion is mainly unrealized valuation losses | I won’t chase panic trades

My approach is to first break down the financial report, then assess whether it represents genuine selling pressure on ETH. Binance Square is discussing #BitMineReports$6.3BNetLossForFiscal2026. BitMine’s 10-K, filed with the SEC on November 10, covers the period through August 31 and reports an annual net loss of approximately $6.313 billion, including approximately $6.229 billion in unrealized losses on digital assets. Unrealized losses reflect changes in fair value on the books; they cannot simply be described as “$6.2 billion of ETH sold that day” or “an equivalent cash outflow.” The report also disclosed net cash outflow from operating activities of approximately $305 million. That is a separate measure: it should not be conflated with book losses, but neither should the pressure of ongoing financing and operations on the company be ignored.

The timing of the holdings matters, too: the 10-K states that as of August 31, the company held approximately 5.9018 million ETH, valued at approximately $14.559 billion. A November 9 news update on the company’s investor relations page said its holdings had reached approximately 6.07 million ETH. These figures refer to different dates: year-end figures cannot be used to describe today, and the November update cannot be used to infer the holdings at the time the annual losses occurred. Whether the company continues to buy or sell should be confirmed through new company announcements and SEC filings; a holdings chart or social media hints are only market expectations.

My independent assessment is that the financial report first and foremost exposes how sensitive the ETH treasury model is to price movements: if ETH falls, the company’s net asset value and financing capacity may come under pressure. Only if the company is forced to raise funds, reduce its holdings, or change its staking arrangements could that pressure potentially feed through to spot supply. Conversely, unrealized losses on the books do not automatically create a spot sell order. The market is already showing a contraction in risk appetite: ETH/USDT on Binance is around $1,904.02, with a 24-hour range of $1,878 to $1,989.11, down approximately 1.28% from 24 hours ago. This does not prove that the financial report caused the decline; macro conditions, ETF flows, and market-wide deleveraging still need to be considered together. The earlier post about ETF staking yields concerned fund distribution mechanisms, which are not the same thing as the treasury risks of this publicly listed company.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. My tentative plan would be to watch and then consider a small long position; my current position is 0%. I would only consider going long with at most 3% of my total capital if ETH regains $1,930 and then holds above $1,900 on a retest, while the company has disclosed no new pressure to sell assets to meet obligations. I would take half off at the first target of $1,960 and reduce the rest at the second target of $1,989. If the price falls below $1,878 after entry, I would close the entire position at a loss. If the price repeatedly fails to hold $1,900, or new SEC filings show that cash pressures have materially worsened, I would cancel the long plan rather than average down. The key factor that could overturn this assessment is actual financing and selling activity—not a loss screenshot on social media.

content:
BitMine亏损登热榜｜63亿美元主要是未实现估值损失｜ETH我不追恐慌单

我的态度是先拆开财报，再判断它对ETH是否构成真实卖压。币安广场正在讨论#BitMineReports$6.3BNetLossForFiscal2026。BitMine于11月10日向SEC提交的10-K，报告期截至8月31日，年度净亏损约63.13亿美元，其中数字资产未实现损失约62.29亿美元。未实现损失是账面公允价值变化，不能直接写成“当天卖掉62亿美元ETH”或“出现同等现金流出”。财报同时披露经营活动净现金流出约3.05亿美元，这是另一个口径，既不能与账面亏损混为一谈，也不能忽略企业持续融资和运营的压力。

持仓时间点同样重要：10-K写的是8月31日持有约590.18万枚ETH、估值约145.59亿美元。公司投资者关系页面的11月9日新闻称持仓达到约607万枚ETH。两者对应不同日期，不能用年末数字描述今天，也不能用11月新闻倒推年度亏损发生时的仓位。公司是否继续买入或卖出，应等待新的公司公告及SEC文件；单张持仓图、社交媒体暗示都只能算市场预期。

我对这件事的独立判断是，财报首先暴露了ETH财库模式的价格敏感性：ETH跌，企业资产净值和融资能力可能承压；若企业被迫融资、减仓或改变质押安排，才可能进一步传到现货供给。反过来，账面浮亏本身不会自动形成一笔现货卖单。市场已显露风险偏好收缩：币安ETH/USDT约1904.02美元，24小时区间1878至1989.11美元，较24小时前约跌1.28%。这不是财报造成跌幅的因果证明，宏观、ETF资金和全市场去杠杆仍需一起看。此前ETF质押收益帖子说的是基金分配机制，与这家上市公司财库风险不是同一件事。

如果是我自己交易，当前不参与，方向暂以观望后的小仓位多单为备选，现仓位0%。只有ETH重新站上1930美元且回踩1900美元不破，同时公司没有披露新的被动售币压力，我才考虑以总资金最多3%试多。第一目标1960美元减半，第二目标1989美元再减；若入场后跌破1878美元，全部止损平仓。若价格反复失守1900，或者新SEC文件显示现金压力显著加重，我撤销多头计划而不是向下加仓。判断被推翻的核心是实际融资与售币行为，不是社交媒体上一张亏损截图。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t an Admission of Being Wrong—it’s the Price of Admission for Another Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to stop out because they see a stop-loss as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest traders I’ve ever seen cut their losses more decisively than anyone. Because they know that whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value across a hundred trades. The next time your hand hesitates when it’s time to stop out, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

从驱动因素来看，以太坊的下跌受到多重压力。首先，现货以太坊交易所交易基金自十月下旬以来持续遭遇赎回，累计净流出超过十一亿美元，机构资金的撤离对价格形成了持续的流动性拖累。其次，中心化交易所的现货抛售加剧，单小时净流出峰值达到三千五百四十万美元，加速了价格跌破一千九百美元支撑。此外，以太坊基金会在五天内抛售了五千枚以太坊，尽管部分鲸鱼在低位承接，但整体卖压仍然沉重。

三、市场情绪分析

从技术因子统计来看，十五个因子中有九个发出做多信号，五个发出做空信号，一个中性。做多比例为百分之六十，做空比例为百分之三十三点三。然而，综合指标显示做空信号的历史胜率为百分之七十三点三，高于做多信号的百分之五十八点八，表明在当前市场结构下空头仍然占据优势。

title: PPI没爆雷，BTC和ETH却崩了！这轮下跌到底是谁在卖？
subTitle:
昨晚PPI公布之前，我的判断是：数据大概率符合预期，美股和BTC有机会迎来一波强势修复。
结果PPI环比上涨0.3%，确实低于市场预期的0.4%，但行情并没有按预想的方向走。

BTC跌破7万美元，ETH一度跌到1900美元附近。
这就有意思了。没有明显超预期的通胀数据，为什么币圈还是跌得这么狠？我查了一圈数据，越来越觉得，这次下跌不是单一利空造成的，而是几个问题集中爆发。

1. 真正可怕的不是利空，而是没人接盘
以前我们总说，机构进场以后，BTC的底部会越来越稳。但机构也不是只买不卖。据CoinDesk 11月13日报道，11月以来美国现货BTC ETF累计净流出约18.8亿美元。
ETF流出不代表机构全部看空，更不代表这些资金全都在同一时间直接砸向现货市场。
但它至少说明一件事：之前支撑行情的重要买盘，最近明显变弱了。市场最怕的就是这种情况。卖的人没有突然多到离谱，但愿意接盘的人少了。价格自然就容易往下掉。
2. 跌破7万以后，杠杆多头成了新的卖盘
我觉得这是本轮下跌最值得关注的地方。
CoinGlass数据显示，截至11月13日相关报道时点，过去24小时加密市场爆仓约16.4亿美元，其中接近九成是多头。
BTC和ETH的多头仓位都遭到了大规模清算。
这意味着什么？
很多人并不是主动看空才卖，而是价格跌到一定位置以后，仓位被强制平掉。
于是形成一个循环：
价格下跌 → 多头爆仓 → 被动卖出 → 价格继续下跌 → 更多多头爆仓。
所以你会发现，币圈有时候明明没有突然出现什么重大新闻，却能在几个小时内跌得特别凶。不是每一笔卖单背后都有一个新的利空，有些卖单只是杠杆撑不住了。
3. PPI虽然低于预期，但加息压力并没有消失这是我之前判断中需要修正的地方。我原本认为，PPI只要不明显超预期，市场就有机会修复。
但忽略了一点：
市场交易的不是单独一个PPI数字，而是未来几个月整个利率环境。这次PPI环比0.3%，确实比预期略好。可同比仍然达到6.5%，通胀压力并没有真正解除。再加上此前的通胀数据偏热，市场对美联储继续加息的担忧仍在。美元走强、美债收益率上升，对BTC、ETH和高估值科技股都不友好。所以这次不能说完全没有利空。准确地说，是没有出现新的PPI爆雷，但旧的宏观压力依然存在。

4. 为什么ETH比BTC更弱？
我认为ETH现在承受的是双重压力。
一方面，它和BTC一样受到宏观风险偏好下降的影响。
另一方面，ETH自身还有杠杆抵押、机构持仓和ETF资金流出的压力。

近期已经有上市公司为了维持链上贷款的抵押安全，被迫亏本出售部分ETH。
这件事值得警惕。
因为价格下跌不仅会影响投资者情绪，还可能触发部分抵押仓位的风险控制。但需要强调，个别机构出售ETH，不等于整个市场都会发生连环清算。真正需要观察的是：ETH继续下跌时，是否出现更多被动减仓。
5. BTC的6.8万支撑，我还看好吗？
我之前明确说过，6.8万美元附近有较强支撑，跌破7万更像是假跌破。现在看来，市场比我预想的弱。但我也不认为，仅凭一次跌破就能证明中长期趋势彻底结束。

接下来我主要看三个信号：
第一，BTC能不能重新站稳7万美元。
如果能收复并维持，说明下方仍有承接。
第二，6.8万美元附近能否重新形成有效支撑。
如果持续跌破、反抽又站不回来，那之前的假跌破判断就需要修正。
第三，ETF资金流出和合约清算能不能缓和。
如果ETF继续流出、杠杆继续被清算，即使短线反弹，也未必能走远。
至于ETH，我会重点观察1900美元附近的价格表现，以及机构去杠杆是否继续。

最后说说我的看法
我现在更倾向于认为：这轮下跌是宏观压力、ETF资金撤离和杠杆清算共同作用的结果，而不是某个神秘主力突然砸盘。当然，也不能因为跌得很急，就直接认定这是洗盘。急跌可能带来修复，也可能只是更大调整中的一次反弹。

我依然希望看到BTC重新站稳7万，但这次会更重视资金面和价格确认，而不是单纯押反弹。之前看多的判断没有完全兑现，就应该拿出来复盘。毕竟做交易，最重要的不是每次都猜对，而是知道自己为什么猜错。大家觉得，这轮BTC和ETH大跌，主要是机构撤资，还是杠杆多头被清洗？

The bottom line: Meta’s prediction market isn’t a product—it’s a stress test. Replacing cash with points breaks compliance risk into smaller pieces, letting them test the waters first.

For big tech companies launching prediction markets, the biggest concern has never been the technology—it’s “does this count as gambling?” Using points to avoid cash settlement effectively puts the licensing question on hold while they test whether users will show up. If it proves viable, adding cash is only a matter of time. That’s when on-chain settlement assets like $ETH  will have a story to tell. Calling it bullish already is way too early.

On another front, the DOJ is seeking to seize $1.2 billion in funds linked to a Binance hack, while also disrupting North Korea’s deepfake scheme. Here’s the takeaway: the blockchain isn’t beyond the law—it’s a crime scene with a trail of evidence. The fact that stolen assets can be traced and targeted for forfeiture shows that law enforcement has a deeper grasp of where funds flow than most people think. For $BNB  holders, this means old cases are being brought back into the light: compliance pressure doesn’t disappear just because the market is up or down.

title: IBIT连亏11个交易日，ETF买盘神话该醒了
subTitle:
两周撤出 23.5 亿美元，BlackRock 的 IBIT 连续 11 个交易日净流出。这不是什么“技术性回调”，而是 ETF 这条最粗的买水管道开始反向抽水。

看单日数据更清楚：上周五美国现货$BTC ETF 净流出 1.854 亿美元，IBIT 一家就占了 1.435 亿，Fidelity 的 FBTC 再走 4,190 万。头部两只同时失血，说明这不是小基金在调仓，而是主渠道在减仓。而且“连续 11 个交易日”比流出金额本身更值得警惕——它意味着每天都有人在按计划卖，不是一次性恐慌砸盘，而是有节奏地撤退。

为什么？ETF 里的钱大多是配置盘，配置盘不看 K 线，看的是仓位比例和波动率。$BTC 波动一放大，模型就自动降低权重，卖出是纪律，不是观点。所以别指望“跌多了 ETF 就回来抄底”，配置盘根本没有“抄底”这个动作，只有“再平衡”。$ETH、$SOL 这些跟着 $BTC 吃 beta 的，ETF 撤资时也别指望能单独走强。

反过来看，这轮流出也在回答一个更扎心的问题：之前那波上涨里，有多少是“被动买入”堆出来的？现货承接力到底有多厚，现在才真正开始测试。潮水退了才知道谁在裸泳，这话对 ETF 同样适用。

真正该问的不是“流出什么时候结束”，而是“如果 ETF 连续一个季度不买，这些货谁来接”？以上内容不构成投资建议。

translatedData.content:
"Now that transactions have moved to L2, does Ethereum mainnet still matter?" That's the wrong question. What matters on mainnet isn't transaction volume, but its ability to collect rent.

According to L2BEAT, all rollups combined processed about 303 million user operations on 11/13, averaging more than 3,500 per second. Ethereum mainnet handled about 25 per second on the same day. There’s no real debate about the activity gap of more than 100x—scaling is supposed to move transactions off-chain.

The question is how much rent L2s pay L1 after moving those transactions off-chain.

Blobscan data shows that since the Dencun upgrade in March 2024, all L2s combined have burned about 4,748 ETH in blob base fees—worth roughly $14.9 million at the prices at the time. That’s over two and a half years. Base alone, the largest contributor, accounts for about 1,694 ETH, or roughly $5.29 million.

Now look at DefiLlama: Base generated about $2.61 million in revenue over the past 30 days. In other words, about two months of Base’s earnings roughly match all the blob fees it paid to Ethereum over two and a half years. Over the same period, Ethereum itself burned about $6.2 million in fees in the past 30 days, and just over $80,000 in the past 24 hours.

That’s the balance-sheet reality behind the narrative that "L2s are Ethereum’s scaling solution": users, fees, and sequencer profits all stay on L2, while L1 gets the prestige of providing security and a little spare change. Blobspace supply is set to a target, and as long as demand doesn’t hit capacity, prices stay at rock bottom. The more L2s thrive, the less likely they are to generate significant ETH burns.

So ETH/BTC’s steady decline over the past few years isn’t entirely down to sentiment. Before touting "record L2 activity" as bullish for ETH, do the rent math. Ethereum either needs blob demand to actually hit capacity, or it needs to bring execution back to mainnet. Otherwise, the more traffic grows, the more it looks like Ethereum is working for other chains.

Data: L2BEAT activity API (11/13 UTC), Blobscan stats (updated 11/14 07:25 UTC), DefiLlama fees API (retrieved 11/14). USD figures are converted by Blobscan using historical prices.
#ETH #L2

content:
"交易都跑L2了，以太坊主网还重要吗"——这问题问错了。主网不重要的不是交易量，是收租能力。

L2BEAT数据，11/13这一天所有rollup合计约3.03亿次用户操作，平均每秒3500多次；以太坊主网同一天约每秒25次。活动量差一百多倍，这个没啥好争的，扩容本来就是要把交易搬出去。

问题在于搬出去之后，L2给L1交了多少房租。

Blobscan统计，2024年3月Dencun升级到现在，所有L2发blob一共烧掉的blob基础费约4,748 ETH，按当时币价折合约1,490万美元。两年半。其中最大的Base一家约1,694 ETH，约529万美元。

再看DefiLlama：Base近30天收入约261万美元。也就是说，Base两个月左右赚的，差不多抵得上它两年半付给以太坊的全部blob费。同期以太坊自己近30天烧掉的手续费约620万美元，24小时才8万出头。

这就是"L2是以太坊的扩容"这套叙事的账面真相：用户、手续费、排序器利润都留在L2，L1拿到的是安全性背书的名义和一点零头。blob空间供给是按目标定的，只要需求没顶满，价格就趴在地板上，L2越繁荣越不一定给ETH带来多少燃烧。

所以ETH/BTC这几年一路往下漏，不完全是情绪。拿"L2活跃度创新高"喊ETH利好的，先把这笔租金账算明白。以太坊要么让blob需求真的顶到上限，要么重新把主网执行做起来，否则流量越大，越像是在给别人的链打工。

数据：L2BEAT activity API（11/13 UTC），Blobscan stats（11/14 07:25 UTC更新），DefiLlama fees API（11/14取），美元为Blobscan按历史价格折算。
#ETH #L2

【If ETH drops to 1,700, who feels the pain first?】

Signal: Bearish, wait and see, don't chase shorts.

ETH is currently at 1,896.64, down 2.3% over 24 hours and 15.5% over 7 days, still below 2,000. The price structure is weak: 2,000 is resistance, while 1,700 is a potential support level below—and a risk line.

If it really reaches 1,700, retail traders won't be the only ones feeling the pain. BTCS sold some of its ETH at a loss to maintain its $64 million Aave loan. It holds 46,676 ETH, and the loan could become eligible for liquidation if ETH reaches around 1,700. The business logic is simple: selling ETH is the only way to add collateral for borrowed money and keep the loan healthy. That's leverage turning against you. Those most affected are highly leveraged bulls and people who treat “panic = bottom” as a safety net.

Trading volume is over 5% of market cap, so positions are changing hands rapidly; the Fear and Greed Index is just 13, far below the weekly average of 25. With volume surging as sentiment worsens, I lean toward further downside momentum and don't think a reversal is imminent. BTC dominance is 58.8%, and capital is also moving to safer ground.

What I learned in 2017: just because prices have fallen a lot doesn't mean it's time to buy. No one guarantees you'll buy at the bottom. I talk big about going all in, but my hands are steadier than anyone's; I know better, yet I still get itchy fingers.

How are you feeling right now: willing to buy this dip, or would you rather miss out?

translatedData.content:
“Buy $10,000 worth of BTC five years ago, and it’s only worth $10,500 now, while gold doubled”—this comparison has been circulating on X over the past couple of days. If it’s making you want to sell everything, hold on a moment and check where they chose to start.

On 2021-11-14, BTC opened at 64,380 on Binance, and peaked at 69,000 that month. In other words, that was the last cycle’s top. Start from a peak, and every asset looks bad.

I ran the numbers myself using Binance spot data. Starting from 2021-11-14, investing the same amount every week through today (261 weeks), BTC is up 1.57x, PAXG (tokenized gold) 1.59x—basically even. Move the start date forward a year to 2022-11-14, the week after FTX collapsed, and BTC is up 4.13x, gold 2.22x, and SOL 5.73x.

So “BTC underperformed gold over five years” is true only under one condition: you went all-in right at the top and didn’t add a cent for five years.

But the asset in these charts that should really keep people up at night isn’t BTC—it’s ETH. A one-time purchase at the top is now worth 0.41x; even after five years of dollar-cost averaging, it’s still only at 0.86x, a 14% loss. SOL bought at the top is worth 0.31x, but dollar-cost averaging gets you to 1.42x. Of the major coins, ETH is the only one where “even buying gradually hasn’t gotten you back to break-even.” ETH/BTC has fallen from 0.072 to 0.028. This isn’t a cycle that hasn’t come around yet—it’s five years of bleeding.

Gold really did double; there’s no need to deny it. But those who cherry-pick the top as their starting point to steer the narrative—whether gold bugs or bears—are selling emotion.

Data: Binance spot daily/weekly opening prices; current prices as of 11/14 15:17 (UTC+8), excluding fees.
#BTC #ETH

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Rolling Positions: Fortune at the Risk of Ruin, or a Liquidation Accelerator?
translatedData.subTitle:
The term “rolling positions” has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital with several times leverage to ride a major trend, roll it over a few times,
and multiply it dozens of times. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【What Rolling Positions Actually Do】Unrealized gains aren’t cashed out; instead, they’re treated as risk capital for opening new positions,
It’s like using the market’s money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; once it stops, unrealized gains can go from
dozens of percentage points to zero in just one or two massive bearish candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】The essence of rolling positions is “being right repeatedly.” If your win rate is 60%, the chance of winning four times in a row
is only 13%. Behind the overnight-doubling posts you see are 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#加仓 #交易干货 #仓位 #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Crashing and Burning
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve read the trend right and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going in heavily right away and adding all your floating profits is a sure way to end up on the liquidation list.
A common mistake. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than the previous time. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
After it confirms again, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position gets, keeping your cost basis weighted toward lower levels so you can weather a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more as the price rises) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses; once you lose your nerve, all your trades go awry.

title: $1.23 Billion Wiped Out in 24 Hours: Can Bitcoin Hold the Line at Its 200-Week Average?
subTitle:
The crypto market just took a heavy hit. Over the past 24 hours, forced liquidations surged to $1.23 billion—nearly double the previous day’s wipeout—dragging the total crypto market cap down 5.75% to $2.33 trillion.
According to Coinglass data, bullish traders bore the brunt of the sell-off, with long positions accounting for 82.7% ($1.02 billion) of the total flush. In total, 163,631 traders were liquidated (up from 112,947 the day before). While roughly $1 billion of the damage happened in the first 12 hours, liquidation pressure has started to cool down, dropping to $233.07 million over the past 12 hours and $41.01 million in the last four.
(Interestingly, despite longs taking the beating, the largest single liquidation order was actually a $17.81 million $ETH short on Binance, closed at $1,979.21.)

Bitcoin ($BTC) Tests a Critical Weekly Level

Bitcoin accounted for more than half of the market wipeout with $637.24 million in liquidations—and a massive 90.8% of those were long bets.
Currently trading around **\(67,623** (down 3.70\% in 24 hours),\)BTC has slipped just below its 200-week Simple Moving Average (SMA) at $67,922. This is the exact same level that caught Bitcoin’s drop back in July and sparked its August rally. All eyes are now on Sunday’s weekly close.
Key $BTC Levels to Watch:
• Immediate Support ($66,000 – $67,000): A strong historical zone that previously acted as tough resistance between June and August.
• Major Demand Zone ($62,300): Buyers stepped in to defend this level twice earlier this year (late February and pre-August breakout). If this breaks, we could see a sweep toward $58,000.
• Upside Resistance ($75,000): The first major hurdle bulls need to reclaim if $BTC bounces.

Ethereum ($ETH) Loses Key Support

Ethereum saw $256.52 million in liquidations over the last 24 hours, with 76.3% coming from long positions.
Trading down 3.37% at **\(1,903.78**,\)ETH has slipped below a key Fibonacci support level at $1,920.51. If sellers keep control, the next major support zone sits down at $1,832.78.

What’s Next for the Market?

Bullish traders have absorbed the majority of liquidations for two straight days, leaving long positions heavily exposed heading into a crucial stretch of macro and institutional events:
1. Sunday’s Weekly Close: Will $BTC  reclaim the $67,922 200-week SMA before the weekly candle closes?

3. December 9 (FOMC Meeting): The Federal Reserve’s upcoming interest rate decision will set the tone for risk assets heading into year-end.

以太坊市场深度分析：机构抄底与抛压并存，短期走势扑朔迷离

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月十四日，以太坊当前报价一千八百九十五美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之一点七。价格从一千九百二十八美元开盘后快速下探至一千八百七十八美元，随后在买盘推动下反弹至一千九百零五美元附近窄幅整理。从小时K线来看，以太坊的跌幅相对比特币较小，显示出一定的抗跌性，但整体仍处于下行通道之中。成交量方面，下跌小时的成交额达到七千二百五十二万美元，明显高于反弹小时的成交量，说明空头力量仍然更强。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现明显的空头排列。七周期均线报一千九百零九美元，二十五周期均线报一千九百三十三美元，九十九周期均线报二千零一十九美元，价格运行在所有主要均线下方。指数移动平均线同样确认空头格局，七周期EMA为一千九百零九美元，二十五周期EMA为一千九百三十五美元，九十九周期EMA为二千零一十六美元。短期均线与长期均线之间的距离较大，表明中期下行趋势尚未结束。

布林带指标显示，当前下轨位于一千八百八十八美元，中轨在一千九百三十一美元，上轨在一千九百七十五美元。价格在下轨附近运行，但尚未有效跌破下轨，说明短期支撑仍然存在。MACD方面，DIF线报负十九点四，DEA线报负十八点五，柱状图为负零点八八。柱状图负值持续收窄，从负一点九四缩小到负零点八八，这是一个积极信号，暗示做空动能正在减弱。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为三十九，十二周期RSI为三十七点三，二十四周期RSI为三十六点五。此前六周期RSI一度跌至十六点六的极端低位，目前已回升至接近四十的水平，显示超卖状况有所改善。KDJ指标中K线为三十六点五，D线为三十三点三，J线为四十三，三线从低位回升并形成多头排列，短期反弹信号较为明确。威廉指标报负六十五点五，从此前的负九十三大幅回升，超卖压力显著释放。

随机RSI指标从十八点三快速攀升至五十一点六，上穿其均线三十三点六，这是一个较强的买入信号。综合来看，以太坊的多项短期技术指标已经出现底部反转迹象，但中期趋势仍然偏空，需要等待价格有效突破七周期均线后才能确认反弹。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场目前呈现出多空交织的复杂格局。从积极面来看，多家机构投资者正在逢低大量买入。知名投资者Chun回购了超过一万零九百枚ETH，七大关联地址吸筹九千七百六十六枚ETH，纽约梅隆银行也推出了ETH机构质押服务。这些大规模买入行为表明，聪明钱正在利用当前的低价区间进行布局。

然而，消极因素同样不容忽视。现货ETF持续出现大额赎回，每周数亿美元的资金流出对价格形成了持续压制。大户抛售压力也十分明显，单小时净流出三千五百四十万美元，大单抛售达两千五百七十万美元，直接触发了价格向一千八百八十四美元的快速下跌。此外，二零一五年的ICO参与者抛售了一万六千七百枚ETH，以太坊基金会也在持续出售，给现货市场带来了严重的供给压力。

从技术面综合因子来看，十五个因子中有六个发出做多信号，八个发出做空信号，综合指标给出做空信号，胜率高达百分之七十六点七。这说明当前空头趋势的可靠性较高，短期内不宜盲目抄底。不过，多项振荡指标已经显示超卖反弹信号，如果宏观面出现利好催化，以太坊有望迎来一波技术性修复行情。建议投资者密切关注一千八百七十八美元的支撑位和一千九百三十三美元的二十五周期均线压力位。

In the medium term, however, if computing power continues to decline, it could help Bitcoin form a bottom. A similar situation occurred at the end of the 2018 bull market, when institutional outflows combined with regulatory pressure to trigger a market crash. What’s different this time is that demand for AI computing power is diverting electricity resources.

A bearish outlook on Bitcoin is currently reasonable, with the key focus being the strength of support at $70,000. title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Afford Losses to Stay in the Game
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means a maximum loss of 200 U per trade. After 10 consecutive losing trades, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account only draws down 20%, a few winning trades can bring you back. By contrast, if you go all in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it just to break even—mathematically, you’re practically out of the game.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%.” It’s “the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
must not exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine the position size.

After six consecutive days of net outflows, one day in positive territory sounds like a turning point has already arrived. First, let’s lay out the numbers.

At 13:20 Beijing time on November 14, TokenPost cited data platform SoSoValue, reporting that U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recorded net inflows of $2.36 million on November 13, ending six consecutive trading days of net outflows. Just the day before, the same group of funds had seen $70.57 million in outflows. The table from fund-flow tracker Farside showed the same direction. That day, only Fidelity’s Ethereum fund, FETH, recorded net inflows, while Grayscale’s Mini Trust continued to see outflows. At around 14:07, Ethereum was trading at approximately $1,906 on Binance Spot.

It’s easy to frame this as institutions re-entering the market. But the amounts don’t add up: $2.36 million is only a fraction of the previous day’s outflows, and it was the inflow into one fund offsetting outflows from another.

After the U.S. market opens on the 16th, check whether net inflows on the new trading day grow significantly. If flows turn negative again from Monday to Tuesday, or inflows remain this small, this day in positive territory won’t be enough to support the claim that the trend has changed.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Scaled take-profits: How to lock in gains while letting profits run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here’s the scaled take-profit strategy I’ve been using.

【Three stages】Stage one: At the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell a third to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose, and your mindset immediately changes. Stage two: At the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another third. Stage three: Let the rest run with a trailing stop; exit if the price falls below the moving average
or the previous swing low, and let your profits run. ⭐

【Why this works】If you sell everything too early, you’ll kick yourself. If you hold everything, you’ll often watch your gains disappear and end up back where you started.

ETH以太坊市场深度分析：多重利空叠加下的弱势格局

一、价格走势分析

截至2026年11月14日凌晨，以太坊报价1897美元，过去24小时跌幅约2.16%。从最近五根一小时K线来看，价格从1932美元一路下滑至1878美元的最低点，随后反弹至1904美元附近，但未能站稳1900美元关口，目前在1892美元附近窄幅震荡。整体走势呈现明显的阶梯式下行格局，每一个反弹的高点都低于前一个高点。

均线系统方面，以太坊同样处于全面空头排列状态。7周期均线位于1911美元，25周期均线位于1933美元，99周期均线则远在2022美元。当前价格运行在所有均线的下方，且与短期均线之间的偏离度在持续扩大。7周期EMA为1907美元，25周期EMA为1937美元，99周期EMA为2018美元，指数均线的下降斜率更为陡峭，反映了近期下跌速度之快。

布林带指标显示，下轨已经下移至1889美元附近，中轨位于1933美元，上轨在1978美元。价格已经跌穿下轨并在下轨下方运行了一段时间，这种极端偏离通常意味着短期存在向中轨回归的技术需求，但在空头趋势未扭转之前，回归的力度和持续性都值得怀疑。

成交量方面，在价格从1928美元急跌至1878美元的那个小时内，成交额达到7252万美元，是正常水平的十倍以上。随后成交量逐步回落至2969万美元，但仍高于平均水平，说明市场在低位有一定的承接力量，但尚不足以扭转下跌趋势。

二、技术指标解读

RSI指标方面，6周期RSI一度跌至16.4的极端超卖水平，随后小幅回升至29.9。12周期RSI为32.3，24周期RSI为33.8，三个周期的RSI均处于30附近的低位区域。与比特币类似，以太坊也进入了技术性超卖区间，短期反弹的概率在增加。

MACD指标呈现持续走弱态势。DIF线为负20.7，DEA线为负18.5，柱状图为负2.27。MACD柱状图已经连续三个周期为负且持续走阔，从零上1.5转为零下1.7再到零下2.3，空头动能在稳步增强。信号线与DIF线之间的差距也在扩大，短期内看不到金叉的迹象。

KDJ指标中K值为25.3、D值为29.6、J值为16.7，三线均处于低位。值得注意的是J值已经跌至16.7的极低水平，历史上这种读数往往伴随着短期的技术性反弹。随机RSI指标读数为24.2，同样处于超卖区域。

威廉指标读数为负81.7，确认超卖状态。ATR指标为21.5美元，较前一周期22.5美元小幅回落，波动率有所收敛但仍处于偏高水平。综合信号系统显示，复合指标给出看空信号，历史胜率为76.67%，空头信号具有较高的可信度。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊面临的市场压力比比特币更为复杂。除了与比特币共同面对的宏观利空之外，以太坊还有其独特的利空因素。

首先，现货以太坊ETF同样遭遇持续赎回。过去五个交易日累计净流出超过3.26亿美元，虽然规模不及比特币ETF，但对于以太坊的市值体量而言，这一比例的流动性抽离影响更为显著。

其次，以太坊基金会持续减持以太坊换取稳定币的操作给市场带来了额外的抛压。更令人担忧的是，早期ICO参与者出现了大额集中抛售，单笔交易就达到了16700个以太坊的规模。这种来自内部人的系统性减持，对市场信心造成了严重打击。

第三，从链上数据来看，虽然出现了部分鲸鱼逢低吸纳的信号，比如七个关联地址累计吸收了20558个以太坊，但这种买入行为并未能阻止价格的持续下滑。结构性卖盘的力量远超选择性买入的承接能力。

从更宏观的角度来看，以太坊相对于比特币的弱势格局已经持续了相当长的时间。在整体市场风险偏好下降的环境下，以太坊作为风险系数更高的资产，承受了更大的抛售压力。1900美元是一个关键的心理关口和技术支撑位，如果有效跌破，下一个支撑区域可能要看1850美元甚至1800美元附近。

不过，极端超卖的技术指标和鲸鱼的逢低吸纳行为表明，市场正在逐步积累反弹的能量。投资者需要密切关注成交量变化和链上资金流向，寻找可能的底部信号。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

Where to place a stop-loss matters more than whether to set one. Too close, and you get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can wipe you out.

【Fixed-percentage method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop may end up right where other traders’ stops are clustered.

【Technical-level stop-loss method】Place it where the structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if this level breaks, it’s evidence that I was wrong.

The moving average system is also fully aligned in a bearish formation. The 7-period moving average is at $1,911, the 25-period moving average at $1,933, and the 99-period moving average much higher, at $2,022. The current price is below all the moving averages, and its deviation from the short-term averages continues to widen. The 7-period EMA is at $1,907, the 25-period EMA at $1,937, and the 99-period EMA at $2,018. The EMAs are declining even more steeply, reflecting the pace of the recent drop.

The Bollinger Bands show the lower band has fallen to around $1,889, the middle band is at $1,933, and the upper band is at $1,978. Regarding trading volume, during the hour in which the price plunged from $1,928 to $1,878, trading volume reached $72.52 million—more than ten times the normal level. Volume then gradually declined to $29.69 million, but remained above average. This indicates some buying support at lower levels, though it is not yet enough to reverse the downtrend.

II. Technical Indicator Interpretation

The 6-period RSI briefly fell to an extremely oversold level of 16.4 before edging back up to 29.9. The 12-period RSI is 32.3, and the 24-period RSI is 33.8. All three RSI readings are in a low range near 30. Like Bitcoin, Ethereum has entered technically oversold territory, increasing the likelihood of a short-term rebound.

The MACD continues to weaken. The DIF line is at -20.7, the DEA line at -18.5, and the histogram at -2.27. The MACD histogram has been negative for three consecutive periods and continues to widen, shifting from +1.5 to -1.7 and then to -2.3. Bearish momentum is steadily strengthening. ETH以太坊市场深度分析：多重利空叠加下的弱势格局

一、价格走势分析

截至2026年11月14日凌晨，以太坊报价1897美元，过去24小时跌幅约2.16%。从最近五根一小时K线来看，价格从1932美元一路下滑至1878美元的最低点，随后反弹至1904美元附近，但未能站稳1900美元关口，目前在1892美元附近窄幅震荡。整体走势呈现明显的阶梯式下行格局，每一个反弹的高点都低于前一个高点。

均线系统方面，以太坊同样处于全面空头排列状态。7周期均线位于1911美元，25周期均线位于1933美元，99周期均线则远在2022美元。当前价格运行在所有均线的下方，且与短期均线之间的偏离度在持续扩大。7周期EMA为1907美元，25周期EMA为1937美元，99周期EMA为2018美元，指数均线的下降斜率更为陡峭，反映了近期下跌速度之快。

布林带指标显示，下轨已经下移至1889美元附近，中轨位于1933美元，上轨在1978美元。价格已经跌穿下轨并在下轨下方运行了一段时间，这种极端偏离通常意味着短期存在向中轨回归的技术需求，但在空头趋势未扭转之前，回归的力度和持续性都值得怀疑。

成交量方面，在价格从1928美元急跌至1878美元的那个小时内，成交额达到7252万美元，是正常水平的十倍以上。随后成交量逐步回落至2969万美元，但仍高于平均水平，说明市场在低位有一定的承接力量，但尚不足以扭转下跌趋势。

二、技术指标解读

RSI指标方面，6周期RSI一度跌至16.4的极端超卖水平，随后小幅回升至29.9。12周期RSI为32.3，24周期RSI为33.8，三个周期的RSI均处于30附近的低位区域。与比特币类似，以太坊也进入了技术性超卖区间，短期反弹的概率在增加。

MACD指标呈现持续走弱态势。DIF线为负20.7，DEA线为负18.5，柱状图为负2.27。MACD柱状图已经连续三个周期为负且持续走阔，从零上1.5转为零下1.7再到零下2.3，空头动能在稳步增强。信号线与DIF线之间的差距也在扩大，短期内看不到金叉的迹象。

KDJ指标中K值为25.3、D值为29.6、J值为16.7，三线均处于低位。值得注意的是J值已经跌至16.7的极低水平，历史上这种读数往往伴随着短期的技术性反弹。随机RSI指标读数为24.2，同样处于超卖区域。

威廉指标读数为负81.7，确认超卖状态。ATR指标为21.5美元，较前一周期22.5美元小幅回落，波动率有所收敛但仍处于偏高水平。综合信号系统显示，复合指标给出看空信号，历史胜率为76.67%，空头信号具有较高的可信度。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊面临的市场压力比比特币更为复杂。除了与比特币共同面对的宏观利空之外，以太坊还有其独特的利空因素。

首先，现货以太坊ETF同样遭遇持续赎回。过去五个交易日累计净流出超过3.26亿美元，虽然规模不及比特币ETF，但对于以太坊的市值体量而言，这一比例的流动性抽离影响更为显著。

其次，以太坊基金会持续减持以太坊换取稳定币的操作给市场带来了额外的抛压。更令人担忧的是，早期ICO参与者出现了大额集中抛售，单笔交易就达到了16700个以太坊的规模。这种来自内部人的系统性减持，对市场信心造成了严重打击。

第三，从链上数据来看，虽然出现了部分鲸鱼逢低吸纳的信号，比如七个关联地址累计吸收了20558个以太坊，但这种买入行为并未能阻止价格的持续下滑。结构性卖盘的力量远超选择性买入的承接能力。

从更宏观的角度来看，以太坊相对于比特币的弱势格局已经持续了相当长的时间。在整体市场风险偏好下降的环境下，以太坊作为风险系数更高的资产，承受了更大的抛售压力。1900美元是一个关键的心理关口和技术支撑位，如果有效跌破，下一个支撑区域可能要看1850美元甚至1800美元附近。

不过，极端超卖的技术指标和鲸鱼的逢低吸纳行为表明，市场正在逐步积累反弹的能量。投资者需要密切关注成交量变化和链上资金流向，寻找可能的底部信号。

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

📰 Louisiana court acts just now: How much room is there for crypto prediction markets?

A Louisiana judge has just ordered Kalshi, Polymarket, and other prediction market companies to halt all event contract activity in the state. The reason: State Attorney General Liz Murrill sued them, and these companies will also have to put up a virtual wall around Louisiana to keep local users from participating. Note that this is separate from the CFTC's directive urging exchanges to abandon this practice—the regulatory landscape is getting more and more complicated.

Why does this news matter?
The root issue isn't that prediction markets themselves are bad; it's that regulators are starting to target specific business models with precision. Historically, after similar regulatory crackdowns, the industry has either been reshaped or found more compliant ways to survive. title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Afford Losses to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means you can lose at most 200 U on a single trade. After 10 losses in a row, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account only draws down 20%, a few winning trades can get you back on track. On the other hand, if you go all in and lose 30% each time,
Three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you’re basically done for.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “when this trade hits its stop-loss, the amount you lose
must not exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine the position size.

Some folks say that the financial crisis happening in the U.S. is an opportunity for us.

That’s just historical momentum at work—the belief that China could rise rapidly after the 2008 financial crisis.

If a financial crisis had hit the U.S. two years ago, there would have been a chance to benefit from it.

But now there’s nothing. China’s real estate debt, local government debt, cutthroat competition in manufacturing, and household consumption are all already under tremendous strain.

If another financial crisis hits abroad, it’ll be a disaster.

Two years ago, we still had some capacity to respond. Now there’s little chance of weathering a crisis while still ensuring a positive return.

It’s more likely to be the last straw that breaks the camel’s back. Instead of fantasizing about a financial crisis in the U.S. creating opportunities in China, we should focus more on how to handle an unexpected crisis and minimize our own losses.

After all, compared with 2008, China’s economy is now much more deeply integrated into international trade. The more you depend on international trade, the harder you get hurt.

That’s an objective fact. We may feel that we’ve held international trade hostage with our supply chains, but the reverse is also true: international trade has us hostage too.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scaling Out of a Position: How to Lock In Profits While Letting Them Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because cutting losses means overcoming fear, while taking profits means overcoming greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out profit-taking strategy I always use.

【Three-stage strategy】Stage 1: At the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), reduce your position by a third to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade is guaranteed not to lose money, and your mindset changes immediately. Stage 2: At the second target
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another third. Stage 3: Let a trailing stop manage the rest; exit if the price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you exit your entire position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you often end up right back where you started.

BTC falls below $67,000 as institutional funds continue to flow out, but the AI computing-power race could bring a new variable to the market.

Bitcoin fell again this week to around 66,890, breaking straight through the psychological $67,000 threshold. Selling pressure is mainly coming from three sources: large institutional investors taking profits, worsening market liquidity, and a fresh cloud over the global economic outlook. That said, it’s not all bad news. Recently, people have noticed that mining difficulty is surging. In particular, AI projects using GPUs for mining have started aggressively snapping up computing hardware, pushing graphics card prices back up. This makes things interesting: on one side, there’s clear selling pressure; on the other, a potential new source of momentum that could bring a surprise on the demand side. Bitcoin.com has drawn up a list of these two opposing forces: the bears have 10 pressure points, but 10 potential rebound catalysts are also gradually taking shape.

Market impact
- Short term: Bearish sentiment is in the driver’s seat, but AI mining’s boost to hardware demand could temporarily stabilize part of the market. Funds may be avoiding risk, but where they are flowing isn’t yet clear.
- Medium term: The industry landscape could change. If AI mining really takes off, traditional mining farms and their technology suppliers could find new opportunities. The regulatory outlook remains uncertain, but institutional investors’ retreat will make the entire market more cautious.

My take
The market is pretty chaotic right now. The rationale behind institutions pulling back is compelling, but in the short term, the AI computing-power race is unlikely to do much to lift BTC prices; it’s more like a shot in the arm for the hardware market. Honestly, I’m about 70% confident in this assessment, and I’ll leave the remaining 30% to the market. Go easy on me if I’m wrong—I’m only trying it with a small position myself. Morgan Stanley ETH fund discloses staking limits | Price falls back to $1,821 | I’ll wait for confirmation from flows and liquidity

I’m cautious and won’t go long just because of an institutional name. On November 13, the U.S. SEC filing database recorded Morgan Stanley’s quarterly report for its Ethereum Trust: as of September 30, the trust held approximately 20,000.265 ETH, with a fair value of about $53.89 million, of which staked ETH was worth about $37.72 million. The report states that, under normal circumstances, management plans to stake 50% to 80% of its ETH holdings, while retaining flexibility to adjust that proportion for redemptions, fees, reward distributions, policy risks, or software vulnerabilities. The holdings are a historical snapshot from the end of September, and the 50% to 80% figure is a policy intention—not a real-time position today or a guarantee of returns.

If institutional ETFs stake their ETH, rewards could increase the funds’ net assets; at the same time, they need to account for redemptions and the time required to unstake. The report lists approximately $35,098 in net staking rewards and about $9,050 in management fees from July 27 to September 30. These amounts are small relative to the fund’s assets and shouldn’t be exaggerated into a source of short-term buying pressure. Compared with BlackRock’s staking fund discussed in the previous update, this filing shows Morgan Stanley’s own risk boundaries: the staking ratio can be lowered in response to redemptions or validator software risks. Institutional participation improves long-term access to investment, but short-term prices still depend on net creations and redemptions, macro funding costs, and spot-market demand.

The market hasn’t automatically strengthened because of this filing. Kraken’s public ETH/USD market showed a price of about $1,821 when I checked, with a 24-hour opening reference of about $1,928 and an intraday low of $1,808. Farside’s figures show that U.S. spot ETH ETFs saw total net inflows of only about $2.3 million on November 13, following net outflows of about $144.8 million and $70.5 million on the previous two days, respectively. Fund flows and the quarterly holdings in this filing cover different time periods; the end-of-September asset figure doesn’t prove that funds are adding to their holdings today. ETH appears among Binance Square’s Most Searched terms, but the current trending searches don’t directly discuss this filing, so I’ll stick to the asset tag rather than bring in unrelated topics.

The key levels I’m watching are the $1,808–$1,810 intraday low zone, $1,840 as the first recovery level, and $1,880 as a further confirmation level. If the price breaks below $1,808 and then fails to rebound, I’ll consider selling pressure to remain dominant. If it holds above $1,880 consistently and fund inflows persist, that would invalidate my cautious view. ETFs don’t trade over the weekend, so we shouldn’t assume flows have returned before they’re updated on the next trading day. Any adjustments to institutional staking policies in response to redemptions or software risks should also be verified against new disclosures.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter now. I’d wait for confirmation before trying a spot long, with a maximum position size of 2% of total capital. The entry trigger would be ETH reclaiming $1,840, holding above $1,830 on a retest, and ETFs not showing renewed large net outflows on the next trading day. I’d remain out of the market until those conditions are met. The first target is $1,880, where I’d reduce the position by half; the second target is $1,920, where I’d halve the remaining position. After entry, I’d set a stop-loss if the price falls below $1,805. If it closes below $1,808 for consecutive one-hour periods, or if a major new staking-security announcement emerges, I’d close the entire remaining position and reassess. Until triggered, these conditions are just a plan; they shouldn’t be described as a trade that has already been entered or as profit already earned.

Sources: Morgan Stanley Ethereum Trust 10-Q filed with the SEC; Farside ETH ETF flow summary; Kraken ETH/USD market data; Binance Square trending and search lists.

摩根士丹利ETH基金披露质押边界｜价格回落至1821美元｜我先等资金与流动性确认

我的态度谨慎，不因机构名字追多。美国SEC文件库在11月13日收录摩根士丹利以太坊信托季度报告：截至9月30日，该信托持有约20000.265枚ETH，公允价值约5389万美元，其中已质押ETH价值约3772万美元。报告写明，通常情况下管理方计划把持有ETH的50%至80%用于质押，但为赎回、费用、奖励分配、政策风险或软件漏洞保留调整空间。持仓是9月底历史截面，50%至80%是政策意向，不是今天实时仓位或保证收益。

机构ETF若质押，奖励可能增加基金净资产；同时需要兼顾赎回与退出质押的时间。报告列出7月27日到9月30日净质押奖励约35098美元、管理费用约9050美元；数额相对基金资产很小，不能放大成短线买盘。与上一轮的贝莱德质押基金相比，这份文件展示摩根士丹利自身的风险边界：遇到赎回或验证器软件风险，质押比例可以下调。机构参与改善长期配置渠道，但短期价格仍取决于净申赎、宏观资金成本与现货承接。

市场并没有因为这份文件自动走强。Kraken的ETH/USD公开行情显示我查看时约1821美元，24小时开盘参考约1928美元，日内低点1808美元；Farside汇总的11月13日美国现货ETH ETF合计净流入仅约230万美元，前两日分别净流出约1.448亿和7050万美元。基金流向与这份季度持仓不是同一个时间口径，不能用9月底资产数字证明今天在增持。币安广场Most Searched包含ETH，但当前上升热榜没有直接讨论这份文件的准确话题，因此我只保留币种标签，不借无关话题。

关键位置我看1808至1810美元的日内低点区、1840美元的第一道修复位和1880美元的进一步确认位。若跌破1808后反抽无力，我会认为卖压仍占上风；若连续站稳1880且基金流入有持续性，谨慎判断才被推翻。周末ETF不交易，流向在下个交易日更新前不能想象为已经回流。机构质押政策若因赎回或软件风险调整，也需以新披露为准。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向是等待确认后试多现货，总资金仓位上限2%。入场触发是ETH收回1840美元、回踩仍守住1830，且下一交易日ETF没有重新出现大额净流出；触发前保持空仓。第一目标1880美元，到位减仓一半；第二目标1920美元，到位再减剩余仓位的一半。入场后跌破1805美元止损；若一小时级别连续收在1808下方，或出现重大质押安全新公告，剩余全部平仓并重新评估。未触发的条件只是一份计划，不能写成已经买入或盈利。

$XRP: Why Effort Justification Can Skew XRP Decisions

$XRP: XRP is trending down hourly while its relative volume sits 2.08x above baseline, and the price sits below the local support level. This combination often tempts a trader to cling to a rule that "high volume validates a move" and to stay invested despite the downside. 

The psychological mechanism at play is effort justification bias: after spending time and analysis on a coin, a trader may overvalue that effort and justify staying the course, even when new data suggest a reversal. The observation of a down direction with strong volume provides a vivid scenario to test this bias. 

One possible reaction is to double‑down, assuming the volume confirms a forthcoming bounce. A competing interpretation is that the volume merely reflects short‑term selling pressure, and the down move may continue. 

A practical self‑check is to ask: "If I had not researched XRP, would I still hold?" If the answer changes, the bias may be influencing the decision. 

A future closed‑candle that shows the price holding above support and RSI 16.2 moving into neutral territory would weaken the effort‑justification argument and suggest a re‑evaluation of the rule.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

For a wider view: $ETH has hourly direction down and volume not above its baseline; $DODO has hourly direction up and volume above its baseline. This alone does not establish correlation.

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place a Stop-Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where to place a stop-loss matters more than whether to set one. Place it too close and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far and one loss can wipe you out.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and blunt, suitable for beginners
and establish discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop could end up right in someone else’s cluster of stop-loss orders.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the structure is invalidated: below key support for a long position; for a short position, place it
above resistance. The logic is—if this level breaks, that’s evidence I was wrong.
Work backward from your position size: if the stop-loss distance is large, reduce your position size to ensure the loss on a single trade is still a portion of your capital

【An itchy trigger finger is one thing; don’t let your legs run wild】

Last week I was watching ETH. I said, “After a drop this brutal, it has to bounce at some point,” but I didn’t make a move. It fell 18.6% in seven days, and my prediction was wrong: being oversold doesn’t mean a reversal is coming. But I was right not to rush into calling the bottom. The FGI is down to 13, well below the weekly average of 25. The market has gone from fearing a drop to fearing that even after it’s over, prices will keep running away.

The most tangible change in the market is that panic has spread to the business side. To secure its $64 million Aave loan, BTCS sold ETH at a loss; if the price falls to around $1,700, the loan could face liquidation. Highly leveraged borrowers and institutions using ETH to generate cash flow are all affected. The logic checks out, but prices can bite back: forced token sales could push prices down further and set off a chain reaction in financing.

MegaETH laid off 20% of its staff and pivoted to AI, while TVL fell from $245 million to $8.8 million. Here’s the reality: users are leaving, liquidity is drying up, and the story hasn’t worked out, so they can only rebrand. For the business model to work, people have to stick around first.

My view changed this week: an oversold bounce doesn’t mean we’ve hit the cycle bottom. What hasn’t changed is that I won’t go all in, and I’ll keep some room to maneuver. I can talk a good game, but when I look back, that itchy trigger finger is still there. Are you afraid of selling at a loss, or looking to buy the dip?

#ETH #加密市场 #BTC #MarketSense

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

shorting, but rather: be especially cautious about going long at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

[State 2: Funding rates stay negative] Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often occur near panic bottoms,
because everyone who was going to run has already run, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in history started at times like this.

title: 都在骂美联储，可水其实是被 AI 抽走的
subTitle:

骂美联储最省力，但数据没那么配合。10 月 PPI 环比 0.3%，低于预期；加息 50 个基点的概率也就 10% 出头。讲道理，这算不上什么新利空。

真正扎眼的是另一组数：稳定币 30 天缩水 142 亿美元，比特币 ETF 连撤六天。场子里的活钱在往外走，这才是真金白银的态度。

钱去哪了？下周 Anthropic 挂牌，认购超额。英伟达、AMD 在跌，可 AI 的 IPO 照样抢破头。机构的现金就这么多，去了那边打新，就没余粮接这边的币。

有意思的是，美联储还是那个美联储，变的只是资金的口味。

所以别光盯着 12 月 8 号的议息会议。加息是明牌，抽水才是暗线。看牌桌上还剩多少钱，比猜庄家下一句说什么重要得多~ 🤔

translatedData.title: Everyone’s blaming the Fed, but AI is what’s really sucking up the liquidity
translatedData.subTitle:
The explanation everyone’s giving for this downturn is that the Fed is going to raise rates.

Blaming the Fed is the easy answer, but the data doesn’t quite support it. October’s PPI rose 0.3% month over month, below expectations; the odds of a 50-basis-point rate hike are only a little over 10%. Honestly, that’s hardly a new bearish catalyst.

What really stands out is another set of numbers: stablecoins shrank by $14.2 billion over 30 days, and Bitcoin ETFs saw six straight days of outflows. Cash is leaving the market—that’s where the real money is telling us it stands.

Where’s the money going? Anthropic is going public next week, and the offering is oversubscribed. Nvidia and AMD are falling, but investors are still scrambling to get into AI IPOs. Institutions only have so much cash. Put it toward that IPO, and there’s less left to buy crypto here.

title: 恐惧指数 20，吓跑你的从来不是盘面
subTitle:
三天，恐惧贪婪指数从 29 掉到 20，极度恐惧😱

过去 24 小时，16 万人爆仓，九成是多单。

你仔细想想，这些爆掉的多单，真的是看错方向了吗？未必。BTC 从 7 万跌到 6.7 万，现货浮亏 5%，扛一扛也就过去了。可你开 20 倍杠杆，5% 的波动就是 100% 的本金。

说白了，杀掉他们的不是行情，是仓位。

我见过太多人，方向看对了，人没了。下跌的时候情绪永远比价格跑得快——价格跌 5%，心态先跌 50%，然后一个操作变形，把本来扛得住的单子亲手割在地板上。

市场永远不缺明星，缺的是寿星。

控制仓位不是什么高深技术，就是给自己留犯错的余地。做你看到的，不做所想的👊

#BTC #ETH #交易心理

translatedData.title: Fear Index at 20: The chart was never what scared you away
translatedData.subTitle:
In three days, the Fear and Greed Index fell from 29 to 20: extreme fear 😱

Over the past 24 hours, 160,000 people were liquidated, and 90% of them were long positions.

Think about it carefully: were these liquidated long positions really wiped out because they got the direction wrong? Not necessarily. If BTC falls from $70,000 to $67,000, your spot position is down 5%—you can just ride it out. But with 20x leverage, a 5% move wipes out 100% of your principal.

Put simply, it wasn’t the market that wiped them out—it was their position size.

I’ve seen far too many people get the direction right and still get wiped out. When prices fall, emotions always move faster than the market: the price drops 5%, but your nerve drops 50%. Then one panicked move goes wrong, and you sell at the bottom a position you could have held through.

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。
