translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is a payment between longs and shorts
that they pay each other. The exchange only collects and distributes it; it doesn’t make money from it.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no expiration date, so how do their prices stay in line with spot prices? That’s what the funding rate is for:
When the contract price is above the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is below the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
The money flows back and forth, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn't happen in an instant; it's a process. Understand how it works, and you'll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds required to open a position. For example, at 10x leverage, it's 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing an “Insufficient Margin” alert,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system starts partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

Market Notes｜$ETH ｜$1.28 million in long liquidations
Definition: When prices move sharply, liquidations often happen in clusters: one batch of positions gets liquidated, pushing prices further and triggering the next batch.
How to read it: “Longs liquidating longs” refers to a drop triggering liquidations of long positions, whose sell orders push prices even lower. A “short squeeze” is when a rise triggers liquidations of short positions, and their buybacks push prices higher.
The same data can mean very different things in different market conditions, so don’t apply any single rule of thumb blindly.

content:
盘面笔记｜$ETH ｜多单强平 128万美元
定义：价格剧烈波动的时候，强平常常扎堆发生：一批单子被平掉，带动价格进一步移动，又触发下一批。
读法：常说的「多杀多」说的是下跌触发多单强平、强平卖单又压低价格；「逼空」就是上涨触发空单强平、买回再推高价格。
同样的数据，放在各种行情里意义往往很不同，不要照搬单条经验。

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you’ll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one at random—and end up taking a big loss.

[Cross margin] All the balance in your account is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you’re less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in an extreme market, losses could wipe out your entire account. It’s like putting all your eggs in one
They’re all supporting each other in the same basket.

[Isolated margin] Only a specific amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and it won’t affect your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

【ETH’s real risk: not falling, but getting liquidated】

Down 5.6% in a day, 17.5% in a week, and 30.9% in a month, ETH has slid from $1,850, while the Fear and Greed Index has fallen to just 13.

I’m more concerned about ETH’s other role: collateral. It’s not just a coin you hold and wait to rise; it’s also the foundation of lending and liquidation mechanisms.

BTCS sold ETH at a loss to keep its $64 million Aave loan healthy. It has pledged 46,676 ETH as collateral, and if ETH falls to around $1,700, the loan could face liquidation. It’s like a mortgage: when home prices fall, the value of the collateral shrinks, and the lender demands more margin. Forced selling then pushes prices lower, creating a reflexive cycle.

In practice, highly leveraged borrowers and collateral-financing firms will be affected. Whether the business model holds up depends on three things: buyers willing to step in, manageable financing costs, and a sufficiently large collateral buffer. When fear hits an extreme and trading volume surges unusually, the most heavily indebted get squeezed first.

For investors, $1,840.71 is support and $1,993.28 is resistance. The more important question is: if ETH drops to $1,700, what can I rely on to withstand liquidation pressure? The answer determines whether to chase a rebound or wait for leverage to flush out.

My view: short-term momentum remains weak. The opportunity may come after pressure on collateral eases—not from trying to catch a falling knife.

Just saw: A $1.95 million long position in the $ETH  perpetual contract was liquidated during this bout of volatility.
People often ask what liquidation means, so here’s my take.
Liquidation (also called getting “rekt”) happens when unrealized losses on a leveraged position cause the margin to fall below the maintenance margin requirement, and the system closes the position according to its rules.
Don’t use more leverage to try to make back your losses. This often leads to a string of liquidations.
The same data can mean very different things in different market conditions, so don’t blindly apply a single experience to every situation.

I’m leaning cautious. Binance Square is discussing “what could drive a rebound in crypto and stocks,” and I think the key thing to verify for ETH is whether funds are consistently flowing back in, rather than focusing on a single day’s positive figure. Farside’s US spot ETH ETF table shows net outflows of about $184.6 million on November 9, about $1.3 million on the 10th, about $144.8 million on the 11th, and about $70.5 million on the 12th. Although November 13 turned positive, with net inflows of about $2.3 million, the five trading days still added up to net outflows of about $398.9 million. The positive figure on the 13th was mainly due to roughly $11.6 million in inflows to FETH, offset by about $9.3 million in outflows from Grayscale ETH. This conclusion applies only to the estimated net creations and redemptions of the ETFs listed in that table. It does not mean that spot ETH is being sold across the entire market, nor can one day of a slight positive flow be taken as proof that institutions have fully returned.

Why does this affect ETH? Changes in ETF shares bring traditional accounts’ allocation appetite into the spot market, but there can be a lag between creations and redemptions, market-maker inventories, and secondary-market trading. Daily net flows cannot be mechanically equated with buying in the next candlestick. When net outflows persist for several days, price rebounds are more likely to encounter profit-taking. For a rebound to be more credible, we should at least see net inflows grow over subsequent trading days while price moves back above a key range. On the macro front, on October 28 the Federal Reserve kept its federal funds target rate at 3.75% to 4%, and its statement continued to emphasize that inflation remains elevated. The October PPI released last Friday also needs to be considered alongside subsequent data; we cannot treat “rate cuts are imminent” as a foregone conclusion. The market has already sent cautious signals. A quick note: during this round of volatility in the $ETH  perpetual contract, a $3.06 million long position was liquidated around 1864.67.
People often ask how to interpret liquidations. Here’s how I see it.
When prices swing sharply, liquidations tend to happen in clusters: one batch of positions gets closed, pushing the price further, which triggers the next batch.
“Long squeeze” refers to falling prices triggering long liquidations, whose sell orders push prices lower; a “short squeeze” is when rising prices trigger short liquidations, and the buybacks push prices higher.
With leveraged positions, first consider whether you can withstand the worst-case scenario, then think about what the signals are saying.

translatedData.content:
Why do people often say Bitcoin needs “6 confirmations,” while Ethereum talks about “finality”?
This is how I understand it: the number of confirmations an exchange requires for a deposit is essentially how long it waits for the transaction to reach a level of finality it considers safe.
Bitcoin has only probabilistic finality: the more blocks added after a transaction, the lower the chance it will be reversed, but theoretically that chance never reaches zero.
My usual approach now: when depositing to or withdrawing from different chains, I keep in mind that finality speeds vary from chain to chain, so a slow arrival doesn’t necessarily mean something has gone wrong.
On Ethereum, the staked $ETH  serves as a guarantee of finality: reversing a finalized block would result in the loss of a huge amount of staked funds.

#ETH

content:
为什么比特币常说“等 6 个确认”，以太坊却说“最终确定”？
我是这么理解的：交易所要求的入账确认数，本质上就是在等交易的最终性达到平台认为安全的程度。
比特币只有概率最终性：交易后面叠的区块越多，被推翻的概率就越低，但理论上不会降到零。
我现在的习惯：在不同链之间充提，各条链的最终性速度不一样，到账慢未必是出了问题。
在以太坊上，质押的 $ETH 就是最终性的担保：推翻已最终确定的区块要损失巨额质押。

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1,000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are just getting started ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U of your own money and use 10x leverage, you actually control
a 1,000U position. If the price rises 1%, you make 10% on your principal; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss of your principal—remember, the loss is calculated based on the total position you borrowed to open.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the price moves against you by around 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you only lose everything after a 10% drop; a drop of around 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact threshold also depends on the margin ratio).

截至2026年11月14日下午，以太坊报价1888.81美元，24小时跌幅约3.4%，价格逼近1880美元关键支撑区域。以太坊在本轮调整中表现弱于比特币，机构资金外流和基金会抛售行为加剧了市场的悲观情绪。

一、价格走势分析

从小时K线来看，以太坊从1913美元区域开始逐步走弱，连续五根小时阴线将价格从1909美元一路压低至1871美元。在跌破1900美元整数关口时，成交量显著放大至2553万美元，是此前时段的两倍以上，表明大量卖单集中涌出。最新一根K线虽有小幅反弹至1871美元，但反弹力度微弱，空头依然牢牢掌控局面。

值得注意的是，以太坊的跌幅在某些时段超过了比特币，反映出市场对以太坊基本面的担忧更为严重。以太坊基金会关联钱包向稳定币转换5000枚ETH（价值约992万美元）的操作，进一步打击了社区情绪。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现标准空头排列，7周期均线1899美元，25周期均线1917美元，99周期均线2002美元，价格运行在所有均线下方且差距持续扩大。EMA指标同样确认空头趋势，EMA7已降至1895美元，EMA25为1917美元，EMA99在1998美元，短中长期均线全面压制。

布林带下轨已降至1871美元，价格刚好触及下轨，带宽持续扩张。MACD指标运行在零轴下方，最新柱状图由正转负，显示空头动能正在加速释放。RSI指标中，6周期RSI降至21.84，已进入极度超卖区域，12周期RSI为29.72，同样接近超卖线。

KDJ指标中J值降至22.94，深度超卖。威廉指标WR达到负84.45，同样处于极端超卖状态。从技术面综合判断，以太坊短期内存在超卖反弹的技术条件，但空头趋势结构完整，反弹空间可能有限。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊现货ETF已连续5个交易日遭遇净流出，累计流出金额超过3.26亿美元，机构投资者的撤退速度令人担忧。与比特币类似，宏观环境的恶化是主要推手。美联储加息预期升温、通胀数据超预期，使得无风险收益率上升，降低了持有零息资产以太坊的吸引力。

不过，也有积极信号值得关注。知名投资人Erik Voorhees和机构鲸鱼7 Siblings在下跌过程中合计买入约69200枚ETH，在1884至1900美元区间形成了部分承接。大户的逢低吸纳行为可能为以太坊提供一定的底部支撑。

从链上数据来看，以太坊网络活跃度保持稳定，Gas费用处于合理水平，说明实际使用需求并未受到价格下跌的显著影响。长期来看，以太坊作为智能合约平台的龙头地位依然稳固，但短期内需要等待宏观环境改善和机构资金回流才能扭转颓势。建议投资者关注1860美元至1880美元区间的支撑力度，若跌破则可能进一步下探至1800美元附近。

Negative gamma is more like a volatility amplifier than a directional signal. That is my central takeaway from this data from Greeks.Live: it holds only if market makers are indeed passively hedging within the range according to their models. Once their hedging cadence changes, the conclusion needs to be reassessed.

According to a report by CoinDesk cited by PANews, data from options platform Greeks.Live shows that Bitcoin and Ethereum are both currently in negative gamma territory. Adam, the platform’s macro researcher, put Bitcoin’s negative gamma range at approximately $58,000 to $72,000, with little positive gamma cushioning below the current price. Mechanically, to maintain directional neutrality in a negative gamma regime, market makers must sell when prices fall and buy when they rise. This amplifies volatility in the direction of the trend rather than stabilizing prices against it.

The implication is that what makes this structure worth watching is not whether it is “bearish or bullish,” but where volatility is coming from. The report notes that this hedging could trigger a chain reaction, turning a modest decline into large-scale liquidations in perpetual futures. Until BTC and ETH return to around the $73,000 gamma flip level, order books may remain fragile and prices may be more momentum-driven. My observation is that negative gamma turns ordinary price moves into stronger buying-high and selling-low pressure. Readers should pay more attention to volatility amplification than treat this as confirmation of a market direction.

As for scenarios, the volatility-amplification hypothesis would be supported if prices remain within the negative gamma band, order book depth thins, and funding rates move in the same direction as prices. If BTC and ETH return to near the $73,000 flip level, the direction of market makers’ hedging may change, invalidating this assessment. One caveat: the source material does not provide specific data on order book depth or funding rates, so both still need to be verified. This article does not constitute investment advice.

title: How are Ethereum spot ETF inflows and outflows looking compared to Bitcoin?

Comparative Derivatives Metrics

Critical Market Dynamics
1. Long-Side Crowding in ETH vs. BTC Short Hedging
While Bitcoin funding rates recently dipped near zero or negative on major exchanges (creating short-squeeze setup potential), Ethereum funding rates remain elevated at +0.0064%. Traders are holding onto bullish directional bets on ETH despite spot price weakness (~$1,900 range), making ETH perpetuals more expensive to maintain long positions.
2. Liquidation Cascades and De-leveraging Rate
Bitcoin's open interest dropped 7.00% in 24 hours, indicating an aggressive reset of leverage. By contrast, Ethereum’s open interest fell by only 3.40%. Because ETH open interest has stayed stubbornly high while spot prices decline, 67% of recent ETH liquidations were long positions.
3. Squeeze Risk Dynamics
Bitcoin: Heavy short accumulation below $70,000 creates a high probability for an upside short squeeze if spot price breaks back above the $70,000–$73,000 resistance band.Ethereum: Slower long unwinding and elevated funding create downside long-liquidation risk if spot ETH falls below its immediate support levels near $1,850–$1,880.

Daly said she would discuss rate hikes with her colleagues at the December meeting and at future meetings, and that they would make decisions collectively based on economic conditions. The Fed raised rates in September and held them steady in October. Markets currently expect a 25-basis-point hike at both the December 8–9 meeting and the January 26–27 meeting next year. Daly also said that over the next one to three months, she would focus on consumer spending, particularly whether consumers cut back during the holiday season because of rising prices. She said spending remains relatively resilient for now, but there are signs in some areas that consumers may gradually be losing their appetite to spend.

ETH upgrade progress hinges on audits | Glamsterdam proposal still under review | Stay disciplined near $1,900

My stance is to remain cautious: Ethereum’s long-term upgrade direction is worth following, but proposals still undergoing testing and audits should not be described as already live. The Ethereum Foundation’s official article on November 6 and its update on November 9 said that Glamsterdam is being validated on testnets, and that EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 will adjust gas charging for some state creation and access. During testing, ChainSecurity found that certain existing gas assumptions relied on by contracts could become invalid after the changes. Core developers therefore decided to delay the Hoodi testnet hard fork until the issues are clarified; the Foundation also said that parallel work on Hegota is continuing. The November 9 update also mentioned receiving reports that four deployed contracts might be affected, and that the relevant protocols are being contacted for review. The November 19 discussion also had no predetermined outcome.

The key point is not that the “upgrade failed,” but that compatibility risks were proactively identified before the upgrade and the pace was slowed. The auditing firm’s technical explanation says that some contracts rely on the amount of gas remaining after a failed external call to decide whether to retry, record the failure, or continue execution. If gas charges and return rules change, conditions that previously held may no longer do so. For the Ethereum ecosystem, checking the execution paths of immutable contracts in advance is more important than rushing to announce a date. The risk mainly concerns applications that rely on specific legacy assumptions; it does not follow that all ETH transfers or staking will be affected, and there is no evidence that the proposal has caused any mainnet failures. Going forward, I’ll pay closer attention to audit reports, whether the specifications are revised, and clear conclusions from developer meetings.

At the market level, the delay may dampen the upgrade narrative in the short term, but reducing unverified compatibility risks also has long-term value. Price may not be driven by this event alone: expectations for macro interest rates, BTC’s performance, and ETF flows can also affect ETH. Kraken’s publicly available ETH/USD quote was around $1,906 in this period, with a 24-hour high of $1,987 and low of $1,875, and an opening price of around $1,928. This indicates that although the price has rebounded from its low, it has not yet recovered to its opening level. I won’t describe this rebound as evidence that the market has accepted the upgrade proposal. $1,900 is a near-term level to watch, $1,935 is the first level to reclaim, $1,985–$2,000 is stronger resistance, and $1,875 is the observed low. If the price falls below $1,875 again, or officials confirm that the compatibility impact has widened, I’ll abandon my view that a short-term recovery is underway.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase the rally; I’d only consider a small, unleveraged spot position. My entry trigger would be the price holding above $1,935, buyers remaining active on a pullback near $1,900, and no new major negative audit findings. If those conditions are met, I’d use no more than 2% of my total capital to try a long position. The first target is $1,985, where I’d take half off; I’d hold the rest for $2,020. I’d set a stop-loss below $1,875 and exit immediately if it is hit. I’d also exit early if the price can’t hold above $1,935 for 24 hours after entry, or if subsequent developer discussions in November indicate that the specifications need substantial rewriting. If the conditions aren’t met, I’ll keep my position at zero and wait for the official conclusions—I won’t portray waiting as having already made a profit.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是保持谨慎：以太坊升级的长期方向值得关注，但不能把尚在测试和审计的提案写成已经上线。以太坊基金会11月6日的官方文章及11月9日更新说，Glamsterdam正在测试网验证，EIP-8037和EIP-8038会调整部分状态创建及访问的gas计费方式。ChainSecurity在测试中发现，某些合约依赖的既有gas假设在变更后可能失效。核心开发者因此决定延后Hoodi测试网硬分叉，等问题厘清；官方同时表示，Hegota的并行工作继续推进。11月9日更新还提到收到四份已部署合约可能受影响的报告，正在联系相关协议复核，11月19日的讨论也没有预设结论。

这条消息的关键不是“升级失败”，而是升级前主动发现兼容性风险并放慢节奏。审计机构的技术说明指出，部分合约会在外部调用失败后依据剩余gas决定是重试、记录失败还是继续执行；gas计费和返回规则改变后，原来成立的条件可能不再成立。对以太坊生态而言，提前检查不可修改合约的执行路径，比仓促给出日期更重要。风险主要针对依赖特定旧假设的应用，不能推断所有ETH转账或质押都会受影响，也没有证据说明主网已经发生这一提案造成的故障。接下来我更重视审计报告、规范是否修订及开发者会议的明确结论。

市场层面，升级延期可能压低短线叙事热度，但降低未经验证的兼容性风险也有长期价值。价格未必只由这一事件决定：宏观利率预期、BTC走势和ETF资金同样会影响ETH。Kraken公开ETH/USD报价本轮约1906美元，近24小时高点1987美元、低点1875美元，开盘约1928美元，说明价格虽从低位回升，仍未恢复到开盘位置。我不会把这一波反弹说成市场已认可升级方案。1900美元是近端观察线，1935美元是第一道回收位，1985至2000美元为更强阻力，1875美元则是已观察到的低点。若价格重新失守1875美元，或官方确认兼容性影响扩大，我会推翻短线修复判断。

如果是我自己交易，此刻不追涨，只考虑无杠杆现货小仓位。入场触发是价格站稳1935美元，回踩1900美元附近仍有买盘，并且审计信息没有出现新的重大负面；满足条件后用总资金最多2%试多。第一目标1985美元，触及减半，余仓看2020美元；止损设在1875美元下方，触及立即平仓。若入场后24小时不能守住1935美元，或11月后续开发者讨论显示规范需要大幅重写，也会提前退出。若条件没有触发，仓位保持为零，等待官方结论，不把等待写成已经获利。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | The Five Rules I Keep Beside My Screen—Sharing Them Exactly as Written
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, people forget every principle. So I wrote them down and stuck them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can't, don't enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop trading for the day. Just watch—don't trade.
5. Withdraw some of your profits. The money you take out is real; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

That's all five. Not one is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they read the market wrong—it's that their execution got distorted. Let's keep each other on track.

【ETH’s real danger isn’t the drop—it’s the liquidation chain】

Down 21.1% in a week, with the Fear & Greed Index at just 13. Don’t automatically equate “cheap” with “time to buy the dip.” In this market, what matters most is whether shrinking collateral will cause leverage to hit the brakes on its own.

ETH liquidations work much like a mortgage default: when collateral loses value, the platform sells it to protect itself. Price pushes things along, forced selling drives prices down, and panic makes the drop even steeper.

Here’s what that looks like in practice: an ETH treasury company sold ETH at a loss to secure its $64 million Aave loan. Who’s affected? The company, Aave’s lenders, and leveraged traders—all of them are caught up in it. Once liquidations begin, market makers and dealers could amplify the selling pressure. Does the business logic make sense? Yes—it’s not a bet against the market, it’s about staying alive. And don’t mistake a forced sale for a sign that ETH’s fundamentals have deteriorated.

Don’t base your decisions on the size of the drop alone. Look at who’s most vulnerable, who will step in to buy after liquidations, and whether real demand has returned. An F&G reading of 13 is just a gauge of sentiment, not an answer on whether we’ve hit bottom. Remember: a decline is selling; liquidation is the trigger for a chain reaction. Are you selling at the bottom, or sitting on the sidelines while others buy the dip? Getting itchy to trade?

title: US PPI Miss May Ease Bitcoin Pressure

A softer-than-expected US Producer Price Index (PPI) report can offer short-term tactical relief to Bitcoin (BTC) selling pressure, but it does not single-handedly reverse a broader macro downtrend.
1. Macro Transmission: How PPI Impacted BTC
Headline Monthly Beat: US final-demand PPI rose 0.3% month-over-month against the 0.4% Wall Street consensus.Relief Rally & Short Squeeze: Because wholesale prices came in cooler than expected on a monthly basis, the market experienced a quick impulse rebound, triggering a rally above $70,000 and triggering over $39 million in short-position liquidations within an hour of the release.Macro Cap: Annualized PPI accelerated to 6.5% YoY, maintaining pressure on overall inflation metrics. As a result, the Federal Reserve remains cautious, capping upside momentum for non-yielding risk assets.
2. Market Structure & Order Flow Drivers
While a soft PPI helps absorb immediate spot selling, three underlying dynamics dictate whether BTC can sustain momentum:
Spot ETF Flows: Sustained relief requires institutional spot buying through US Spot Bitcoin ETFs. Persistent net outflows neutralize short-term macroeconomic tailwinds.Derivative Leverage: Liquidations of over-leveraged short positions create fast upside candles (short squeezes), but long-term upside requires structural spot spot-driven demand rather than futures squeezes.Liquidity Conditions: Contracted stablecoin supply reduces liquid capital available on crypto exchanges to absorb aggressive spot selling.

Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly make money in this market are those who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day adds up to 12x over 250 trading days in a year; steadily earning 10% a month
adds up to 30x over three years. It may not sound exciting, but it has one magical quality—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market opportunities have to be waited for; discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the former comes from the market;
the ability to do the latter is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital get to keep playing.

Breaking down VanEck’s Ethereum Fund quarterly report | NAV gains came mainly from ETH’s price, not an expansion in shares | Wait for confirmation before ETH’s drop to 1,783

My stance is cautious: I wouldn’t treat the fund’s rising NAV as evidence of fresh institutional buying that day. VanEck Ethereum ETF (ETHV)’s recently disclosed SEC quarterly report shows that the fund’s net assets rose from about $77.83 million at the end of June to about $132.8 million at the end of September, an increase of roughly 70.7%. Over the same period, the ETH price used in the report rose about 69.5%, while the number of fund shares increased only from 3.35 million to 3.375 million. In other words, the increase in NAV during the third quarter was driven mainly by the revaluation of the underlying ETH, with a net increase of just 25,000 shares. Looking further back to the end of 2025, the number of shares fell from 3.625 million to 3.375 million by the end of September. Different start and end dates can lead to different conclusions; one NAV chart shouldn’t be presented as evidence of sustained, large-scale inflows.

The fund’s filing also says that share creations and redemptions can be completed by authorized participants in cash or in-kind with ETH: for cash redemptions, the fund may sell the corresponding ETH to liquidity providers; for in-kind redemptions, it delivers ETH to authorized participants. Ordinary investors trading ETHV shares on the secondary market do not automatically mean the fund buys or sells an equivalent amount of ETH that day. This mechanism matters when assessing market impact, and it’s why I prefer to look separately at changes in shares, ETH holdings, and daily net flows. VanEck’s website confirms that ETHV is a passive product tracking the price of ETH, less fees, with an annual expense ratio of 0.20%; it won’t proactively stop losses for investors when ETH rises. Farside’s tally of U.S. ETH fund flows on November 13 shows net inflows of about $2.3 million overall, but that represents just one trading day and cannot offset the flows of previous days or current price pressure.

The market’s reaction right now is quite direct. At the time of writing, ETH/USD on Kraken was around $1,783, with an intraday low of about $1,750.7 and an opening price of about $1,928.2—very close to a recent support level. The quarterly report reflects holdings at the end of September, not today’s transaction records; I wouldn’t attribute the current decline to the VanEck filing. Rebound and macro discussions remain active on Binance Square’s trending list, and ETH is on the Most Searched list, but search interest is no substitute for spot-market confirmation. I view $1,750 as near-term support, $1,810 as the initial recovery level, and $1,845 as the next resistance. If ETH breaks below $1,750 again and fails to rebound, the rebound thesis should be abandoned. I’d only consider revising my outlook upward if the fund’s subsequent net flows improve consistently and the price stabilizes above $1,845. Any new developments in exchange security or macro liquidity would also require a reassessment.

If I were trading this myself: I wouldn’t enter now. I’d only consider a small spot position for a rebound long. The entry trigger would be ETH reclaiming $1,810 and holding above it for two consecutive one-hour candles; I’d enter only if a retest holds, with a position size of 2.5% of total trading capital. The first target is $1,845, where I’d take half off; the second is $1,880, near which I’d reduce the position further. I’d place the stop-loss below $1,748. If ETH breaks below $1,750 before entry, I’d cancel the plan immediately. If, after entry, it falls back below $1,810 and fails to reclaim it for two hours, or official data reveals a significant new risk, I’d close the entire position. I wouldn’t use high leverage or present an untriggered plan as an executed trade or a return.

Sources: VanEck ETHV’s quarterly report filed with the SEC, VanEck’s product page, Farside fund flows, Kraken public market data, and Binance Square’s trending list. #ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

VanEck以太坊基金季报拆解｜净值上涨主要靠币价而非份额扩张｜ETH跌至1783先等确认

我的态度是谨慎，不把基金净值上涨当作当日新增机构买盘。VanEck Ethereum ETF（ETHV）最近披露的SEC三季报显示，基金净资产从6月末约7783万美元升至9月末约1.328亿美元，增幅约70.7%；同一期间报告采用的ETH价格上涨约69.5%，基金份额仅从335万份增至337.5万份。换句话说，三季度净值变大主要由底层ETH价格重估驱动，份额只净增2.5万份。若把时间拉长到2025年末，份额则从362.5万份降到9月末的337.5万份。不同起止点会给出不同结论，不能把一张净值图写成持续的大规模申购。

基金文件还说明，份额申购和赎回可以由授权参与者以现金或ETH实物完成：现金赎回时，基金可能把相应ETH卖给流动性提供方；实物赎回则向授权参与者交付ETH。二级市场普通投资者买卖ETHV份额，并不自动等于基金当天买卖同等数量的ETH。这个机制关系到市场冲击的判断，也解释为何我更愿意把份额变化、持币数量和每日净流分开看。VanEck官网确认ETHV是跟踪ETH价格、扣除费用的被动产品，年费率0.20%；它不会因为ETH上涨而主动替投资者止损。Farside汇总的11月13日美国ETH基金总体净流入约230万美元，只代表一个交易日，无法抹平前几日资金流与当前价格压力。

市场此刻的反应相当直接。写稿时Kraken ETH/USD约1783美元，日内低点约1750.7，开盘约1928.2，距离近期防守线很近。季报对应的是9月末持仓，不是今天的成交回执；我不会把眼前跌势归因于VanEck文件。币安广场热榜上反弹和宏观讨论仍热，ETH位于Most Searched名单，但搜索热度不能替代现货确认。我把1750视为近期低位防守，1810为初步收复位，1845为下一道阻力。若再破1750且反抽失败，反弹判断应撤销；若基金后续净流持续改善、价格收稳1845，才考虑上修。交易所安全或宏观流动性出现新变化，也须重新评估。

如果是我自己交易：现在不参与，方向只准备现货小仓位反弹多单。入场触发是ETH重新站上1810美元并连续两根一小时K线收稳，回踩不破才执行，仓位为总交易资金的2.5%。第一目标1845，到达减半；第二目标1880，接近时再减仓。止损放在1748下方。未入场先破1750，计划立即取消；入场后又跌回1810并持续两小时无法收复，或官方数据出现新的重大风险，我会全部平仓。不使用高杠杆，也不把未触发的计划写成成交或收益。

来源：VanEck ETHV向SEC提交的三季报、VanEck产品页、Farside基金资金流、Kraken公开行情和币安广场热榜。#ETH

以太坊市场深度分析：超卖程度历史罕见，多重利空叠加考验信心

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月十四日，以太坊现货价格报一千八百二十二美元，过去二十四小时跌幅约百分之七点六，价格从一千八百四十三美元附近快速下探至一千七百五十一美元，创下近期新低。小时级别K线显示，最近五个时段呈现加速下跌态势，收盘价从一千八百四十三美元逐步走低至一千七百八十二美元，空头完全掌控盘面。

成交量方面，最近两个小时的成交额分别达到七千二百一十一万美元和四千八百七十二万美元，较此前时段大幅放大，放量下跌的格局表明卖压沉重，市场缺乏有效的承接力量。从更广泛的视角来看，以太坊现货ETF持续遭遇赎回，叠加以太坊基金会关联钱包的周期性抛售，现货市场的买盘深度严重不足。

基本面上，以太坊网络升级进度不及预期。Hoodi测试网推迟上线，Glamsterdam升级因智能合约漏洞问题而暂停，这些技术层面的不确定性削弱了市场对以太坊生态发展路径的信心。与此同时，MegaETH母公司裁员百分之二十并转向AI赛道，也反映出以太坊二层生态面临的战略调整压力。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现典型的空头排列格局。七周期均线位于一千八百二十美元，二十五周期均线位于一千八百八十二美元，九十九周期均线高于一千九百八十六美元。价格运行在所有主要均线下方，且短期均线加速向下弯曲，表明中短期趋势明确偏空。指数均线方面，EMA七位于一千八百一十九美元，EMA二十五位于一千八百七十三美元，EMA九十九位于一千九百七十四美元，同样形成层层压制的空头结构。

布林带指标显示，价格已跌破下轨一千七百八十七美元附近，布林带开口持续扩大，中轨位于一千八百七十一美元，上轨在一千九百五十四美元。价格偏离下轨的程度较大，从统计回归的角度来看存在向中轨修复的可能，但趋势性交易中以顺势为主，不宜盲目抄底。

MACD指标深度走弱，DIF线降至负三十五点六二，DEA线降至负二十七点四零，柱状图负值扩大至负八点二一，空头动能持续增强且未见收敛迹象。RSI六周期指标降至十五点八二，已处于极度超卖区域，这一读数在历史上较为罕见。十二周期RSI为二十一点一二，二十四周期RSI为二十六点一五，均处于严重超卖状态。

KDJ指标中K值十九点三零、D值二十二点六六、J值十二点五七，三线均在低位运行。威廉指标WR降至负八十一点七零，此前一度触及负九十二点零一的极端水平。ATR指标升至二十七点五一，波动率明显放大。综合来看，短期超卖信号极为强烈，但在空头趋势未扭转之前，超卖并不等于立即反弹。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临多重利空交织的复杂局面。资金面上，现货ETF持续赎回叠加基金会抛售，形成了稳定的卖压来源。技术面上，升级延迟和合约漏洞问题动摇了部分长期持有者的信心。宏观面上，美联储加息预期升温和全球风险偏好下降，进一步压制了以太坊的价格表现。

值得注意的是，纽约证券交易所选择Avalanche作为代币化股票结算基础设施的消息，虽然对整个区块链行业是利好，但也反映出以太坊在机构级应用场景中面临来自其他公链的竞争压力。市场情绪整体偏悲观，恐慌与贪婪指数处于低位，短期内需要看到ETF资金流向逆转或升级进展明确推进，才可能扭转当前的弱势格局。

对于持仓投资者而言，当前阶段应以风险控制为优先考量，避免在趋势未明的情况下大幅加仓。对于观望者而言，可以关注RSI是否出现底背离、成交量是否出现放量企稳等信号，等待更明确的入场时机。

translatedData.content:
As soon as a headline like “$360 million liquidated in 5 minutes” appears, the comments start saying the market’s been flushed out and a rebound is due. I checked Binance futures data, and the conclusion is exactly the opposite: the flush was shallow, and dip buyers have already rushed back in.

All times are UTC+8. In the 5-minute candle at 4:50, BTC perpetuals plunged from 65417 to 64469.5, with 544 million U in volume. The previous candle had only 10.4 million—50 times less. Aggressive buyers accounted for just 30%, so this really was a concentrated sell-off. In that same 5-minute period, spot BTCUSDT volume was only 59.2 million, while futures volume was more than nine times higher. This plunge was driven by futures trading.

But what about open interest? BTC perpetual OI fell from 97793 coins to 97257, a drop of just 0.55%. ETH fell more, from 2.386 million coins to 2.329 million, down 2.4%. The $360 million figure came from WatcherGuru as a market-wide number. I can’t verify the full-market figures, but looking only at Binance, this decline is nowhere near enough to call it “deleveraging.”

What happened next was even uglier. From 5:00 to 5:10, BTC OI climbed back from 97257 to 97548, and ETH also added more than 12,000 coins, while prices kept falling: BTC hit 64227.5 at 5:10, and ETH fell to 1758.5—both below the liquidation wick at 4:50. Rising open interest alongside fresh price lows suggests new positions were entering, but they weren’t able to support prices.

The long/short account ratios were still 2.86 for BTC and 3.11 for ETH. The top traders’ position long/short ratio was around 1.79, while retail traders were still overwhelmingly long. An increase in OI alone can’t tell us whether the new positions are longs or shorts, but given these ratios, I lean toward the view that dip-buying longs have piled back in.

A liquidation wick isn’t a bottom; it just sends a batch of traders out the door. Wait until OI actually comes down and the long/short ratio is no longer three to one before calling the market flushed out. With the current setup, there’s still fuel below.

#BTC #ETH

浮亏50%的人在看什么？在看「历史最高价」，心里念叨：回到我的成本，

它只认当下的供需。

扛起单之后，你会自动收集利好、屏蔽利空，这叫确认偏误。你会觉得

解药其实很简单，但很难做到：开仓前就写好「什么情况下这笔单的逻辑
失效」，到点执行，不看心情。把决策从持有中剥离出来，你才能看清
盘面在说什么，而不是你想听什么。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You Hold on to a Losing Trade, Your Brain Is Lying to You
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% on a trade looking at? The “all-time high,” thinking, “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Watch out: that thought is pure attachment, with no logic behind it. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the present.

After opening a position, you automatically collect good news and filter out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You start thinking,
“This time is different.” Those five words have historically cost more money than any hacker.

The antidote is simple, but hard to put into practice: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
fails,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate decision-making from holding a position, and you’ll be able to see clearly.

translatedData.content:
Ethereum Foundation showcases Bhutan’s digital identity case | What goes on-chain is the verification registry | ETH still needs to hold above 1,860

My view is positive on real-world use cases over the long term, but in the short term I’ll continue to respect price action and capital flows. On November 3, the Ethereum Foundation published a feature on public digital infrastructure, highlighting Bhutan’s national digital identity system as a real-world example: individuals keep credentials in their own wallets and decide for themselves what to disclose to service providers; shared registry information on Ethereum helps providers verify that credentials are genuine, while personal data itself is not publicly recorded on-chain. Both the Foundation’s case-study page and materials from Bhutan’s digital identity project describe the system’s integration with Ethereum. It’s important to distinguish the identity system already in operation from a separate humanitarian-aid proof of concept by the Foundation; the latter should not be described as already being commercially deployed at scale.

This matters for ETH because it demonstrates that public blockchains can be used for cross-institutional verification, trusted registries, and privacy protection—not just trading and speculation. If more public services adopt similar architectures, developers and institutions will place greater demands on network reliability, long-term maintenance, and compliant interactions. However, identity verification does not mean that every service interaction consumes large amounts of ETH on mainnet, and user numbers cannot simply be multiplied into token-buying demand. What matters is tracking on-chain transaction volume, sources of fee revenue, deployment layers, who pays gas, and whether projects remain in operation. The impact of application value on ETH’s price could take a long time to materialize, or could be offset by lower per-transaction fees resulting from scaling.

The market is not rallying on this case alone. At the time of writing, ETH/USD was around $1,825 on Kraken, with a 24-hour low of about $1,808 and a high of about $1,935; the pullback from the high is more important in determining positioning this time around than any single application case. I’m treating $1,808 as the current risk line, with $1,860 as the first level to watch on the upside, followed by $1,900. If $1,808 breaks and the price cannot reclaim it on a bounce, my short-term rebound thesis is invalidated. If official sources later disclose sustained usage data, ETF flows improve, and the price holds above $1,900, I’ll assign greater weight to demand actually materializing. The November 3 announcement should not be presented as a newly signed national partnership today, nor should anyone claim that the Bhutanese government is buying ETH tonight.

If I were trading this myself: I would stay out for now and only prepare a small spot long position. The entry trigger is for ETH to move back above $1,860, close two consecutive one-hour candles above that level, and hold it on a retest. If triggered, the position would be 4% of total trading capital. The first target is $1,900, where I’d halve the position; the second target is $1,930, near which I’d continue reducing it. The stop-loss is below $1,808; if that level breaks before entry, I’ll cancel the plan. After entry, if the price falls back below $1,860 and cannot recover it for two consecutive hours, or if more recent capital-flow data weaken significantly, I’ll close the remaining position. Without a trigger, this is only a plan—not a trade, and certainly not a fabricated profit.

Sources: Ethereum Foundation feature and Bhutan NDI case study, official Bhutan NDI materials, and publicly available Kraken market data. #ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

以太坊基金会展示不丹数字身份案例｜上链的是验证登记｜ETH仍要先站稳1860

我的态度是看好长期真实用途，但短线继续尊重价格和资金。以太坊基金会11月3日发布公共数字基础设施专题，把不丹国家数字身份列为实际案例：个人把凭证保存在自己的钱包里，自行决定向服务机构披露什么；以太坊上的共享登记信息帮助服务方核验凭证真伪，个人资料本身不公开写进链上。基金会案例页和不丹数字身份项目资料均说明系统与以太坊的集成。这里要分清已运行的身份系统和基金会另一个人道援助概念验证，后者不能写成已经大规模商用。

这条信息之所以与ETH有关，是因为它展示了公有链除了交易投机，还有跨机构验证、可信登记和隐私保护的使用场景。若更多公共服务采用类似架构，开发者和机构对网络可靠性、长期维护和合规交互的要求会提高。不过，身份核验并不意味着每次服务调用都在主网消耗大量ETH，更不能把用户数量直接乘成代币买盘。真正需要追踪的是链上交易量、手续费来源、部署层级、由谁承担gas，以及项目是否持续运行。应用价值到ETH价格的传导可能很慢，也可能被扩容降低单次费用的效果抵消。

市场现在并未因为这个案例独立走强。写稿时Kraken的ETH/USD约1825美元，近24小时低点约1808美元，高点约1935美元；从高位回落的现实，比单个应用案例更能决定本轮仓位。我把1808作为当前风险线，向上先看1860，再看1900。若1808被跌破且反抽无法站回，短线反弹判断就推翻；若官方未来披露持续使用数据、ETF资金流改善并且价格站稳1900，我才会提高对需求落地的权重。不能把11月3日的介绍当成今天新签署的国家合作，也不能说不丹政府今夜买入ETH。

如果是我自己交易：现在不参与，只准备现货轻仓多单。入场触发是ETH重新站上1860美元、连续两根一小时K线收在其上，回踩不破；触发后仓位为总交易资金的4%。第一目标1900，达到后减半；第二目标1930，接近时继续减仓。止损设在1808下方；入场前先破1808就取消计划。入场后若跌回1860并连续两小时无法收复，或更近的资金数据显著转弱，我会把剩余仓位平掉。没有触发就只是计划，不算成交，更不虚构收益。

来源：以太坊基金会专题及不丹NDI案例、不丹NDI官方资料、Kraken公开行情。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A stop-loss isn’t admitting you’re wrong—it’s buying a ticket to the next opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people hesitate to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it differently: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The steadiest trader I’ve ever seen cuts his losses more decisively than anyone. Because he knows: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself
this is the price of admission, not a verdict.

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: Multiple Negative Factors Combine, Making a Short-Term Rebound Difficult

November 14, 2026

1. Price Trend Analysis

As of the early hours of November 15, Beijing time, Ethereum was trading at $1,830, down approximately 6.3% over the past 24 hours—a significantly larger decline than Bitcoin's. Over the past few hours, the price has fluctuated within a narrow range of $1,825 to $1,843, showing an overall pattern of weak consolidation. Looking at the moving averages, the price is well below the 7-day moving average of $1,838, the 25-day moving average of $1,891, and the 99-day moving average of $1,989. The three moving averages are bearishly aligned, confirming a clear downtrend.

In addition to the macroeconomic factors Ethereum shares with Bitcoin, this latest decline has been driven by several Ethereum-specific headwinds. First, the Ethereum Foundation has continued to sell ETH from its treasury, adding further selling pressure to the market. Second, the much-anticipated Glamsterdam upgrade has been delayed, while the Hoodi testnet has also been suspended, undermining confidence among developers and investors. Third, spot Ethereum ETFs have continued to see redemptions, with institutional funds posting net outflows for several consecutive weeks, limiting the recovery of liquidity.

According to the Bollinger Bands, the price has already fallen below the lower band, which is near $1,814, and is in oversold territory in the short term. However, given the weakness of the overall trend, a drop below the lower band does not necessarily mean an immediate rebound. It is worth monitoring whether the price can quickly move back above the lower band.

2. Technical Indicator Analysis

Technical indicators on the one-hour chart also show that bearish momentum is dominant for Ethereum. Of the 15 factor signals, 8 are bearish and 7 are bullish, putting the proportion of bearish signals at 53.3%, slightly higher than that of bullish signals. The composite signal from the overall indicators is bearish, with a historical win rate as high as 76.7%, suggesting that the bearish signal is relatively reliable.

The MACD continues to run below the zero line. The MACD line is at -28.6, the signal line is at -24.6, and the histogram is at -4.08. Although the histogram's negative value has narrowed somewhat, it remains in bearish territory, and the gap between the MACD line and the signal line is still substantial, making a short-term bullish crossover unlikely.

As for the RSI, the 6-period RSI is around 28.8, the 12-period RSI is around 29.5, and the 24-period RSI is around 31.6. The RSI for all three periods is in oversold territory below 30. On the KDJ indicator, the K line is at 23.1, the D line at 25.9, and the J line at 17.7. One indicator worth watching is the Stochastic RSI, which has risen rapidly from 0.2 to around 34, while its moving average is at 30.7. This suggests that some rebound momentum is building after the short-term oversold conditions. The ATR is approximately 22.2, while the standard deviation has fallen from 29.2 to 5.7. Volatility has contracted sharply, suggesting the market may be awaiting a new catalyst to determine its next direction.

3. Market Sentiment Analysis

Sentiment in the Ethereum market is currently quite subdued. Ethereum's larger decline compared with Bitcoin's indicates that the market is more concerned about Ethereum's fundamentals. The combination of Foundation selling and upgrade delays has raised doubts among investors about Ethereum's medium- to long-term prospects.

There are, however, some positive developments worth noting. The New York Stock Exchange's selection of Avalanche for tokenized stock settlement is directly positive for AVAX, but it also shows that institutional adoption across the broader blockchain ecosystem is accelerating. As the pioneer of smart contract platforms, Ethereum still has a breadth and depth of ecosystem that other public blockchains find difficult to match. If the macroeconomic environment improves or the upgrade process resumes, Ethereum could see a recovery rebound.

ETH fell to $1,829, down 18.2% in 7 days, while the Fear & Greed Index dropped to just 13. It couldn’t even hold above the weekly average of 25, indicating that the market has moved from “fear of falling” into a deleveraging phase.

This is no longer just an emotional sell-off; collateral, borrowing, and forced selling have become links in a chain. At the business level, treasury companies that use “crypto holdings as collateral for financing” will all be affected. Financing costs, interest rates, and liquidation buffers must be able to withstand ETH volatility. Otherwise, the more crypto they hold, the more vulnerable they become to forced liquidations.

Exchange net flows and active addresses don’t yet have complete readings, so I won’t pass off trading volume as on-chain data. What we can confirm is that selling pressure from major holders and extreme fear are reinforcing each other. In the medium term, watch whether net outflows ease and active addresses recover, rather than trying to guess the bottom.

On-chain data doesn’t lie. What do you think: is this the final round of deleveraging, or a changing of hands ahead of the next market rally?

title: ETH breaks $1,900 as ETFs pull $696M — $1,717 forced-sale line 6% away
subTitle:
$1,900 didn't hold. I called it tagged yesterday — tonight it broke, and $ETH sits at $1,825 with a listed company's forced-sale line just 6% below. Someone else's loan now decides what happens next.

WHAT HAPPENED

$ETH is $1,825.64 at 19:23 UTC (Finnhub, Binance ETH/USDT), down 6.34% on the day, range $1,811.29–$1,956.50. Sonic Wallet, Hotcoin and BlocFolio agree: $1,820–$1,841 between 17:00 and 18:00 UTC.

The fall came in steps I should own. The $2,060 floor broke on the 10 Nov close ($2,053.21); $1,900 got tagged on 13 Nov ($1,895.95 low, close $1,929.88). Today it broke for real — $1,811.29, the lowest print since August.

Beside it, $BTC is $65,596.95 at 19:29 UTC (Finnhub), day low exactly $65,000, down 4.98%; spot BTC ETFs lost $185.4M on 13 Nov, a seventh straight outflow day. Fear and Greed is 13.

WHY IT MATTERS

The ETF money is leaving, not dipping. US spot ETH ETFs lost $144.8M on 11 Nov — BlackRock's ETHA alone $129.8M — then $70.5M more on 12 Nov (Farside, via Analytics Insight and Coinpaper). November's total to 11 Nov is $695.9M out, the sixth straight week of outflows. Redemptions aren't panic, but they are real selling.

The leverage got flushed into the break: about $249.8M of ETH positions liquidated in 24 hours (CoinGlass, via Analytics Insight, 13 Nov). Once $1,900 gave way, longs had nowhere to hide.

The whales are fighting each other. Lookonchain (via The Coin Republic, 14 Nov): one whale sold 16,700 ETH (~$30.94M), an Ethereum Foundation-linked wallet sold 3,000 ETH. Buyers took 10,380 ETH ($19.91M) and 9,766 ETH at $1,933 — ~$39M bought vs ~$34M sold. No clean whale signal, only a fight.

Then the line. BTCS, a listed ETH treasury firm, sold ETH at a loss to keep its $64.1M Aave loan healthy (CoinDesk, via KWIZERANA, 14 Nov; BTCS 10-Q filed 12 Nov). CoinDesk's estimated liquidation line on that loan is $1,717 — roughly 6% below tonight's price. It's an estimate, and BTCS can add collateral or repay, so it's not a guaranteed sale. But one more leg down turns a listed company into a forced seller.

What keeps me from calling this a collapse: 36.5% of all ETH is staked (44.6M ETH, 904,393 queued to enter — Coinpaper, 14 Nov). The sellers are the ETF and leveraged crowd. A financial sell-off, not a network failure.

LEVELS AND THE PLAN

I'm leaning bearish under $1,900 — leaning, not strong: the whale dip-buying and record staking keep me from calling it one-way. The 20-day average is $2,194.07, far above here.

The trigger is $1,800. A daily close under it opens $1,754.28 (Flicker, 17:00 UTC), then the $1,717 BTCS line. A close back above $1,900 kills the breakdown view; $1,927.62 is the first reclaim target.

What would prove me wrong: a daily close above $1,900 kills the short-leaning view outright; a close under $1,800 confirms the next leg. Weekend liquidity is thin, so a wick under $1,800 that closes back above it means nothing — only the close counts.

The risk to the bearish lean is a squeeze: Fear is 13, BTC's daily RSI is 22.3 (Coinlab, 14 Nov), everyone leaning the same way. Glamsterdam's findings are only reviewed on 19 Nov (Analytics Insight, 13 Nov) — Hoodi still has no new date.

MY NEXT UPDATE

I'll post the moment the daily close lands either side of $1,800 — or sooner if $1,754.28 breaks intraday. That decides whether the BTCS line comes into play.

If $1,800 breaks tonight, are you buying the $1,754 dip or waiting for $1,717 — and what would change your mind?

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune at the Risk of Ruin, or a Liquidation Accelerator?
translatedData.subTitle:
Compounding positions has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital with several times leverage to ride a major trend, then compound several times
to multiply your money dozens of times. Today, let's talk about the part they don't tell you.

【What compounding positions involves】Instead of cashing out floating profits, you use them as risk capital for new positions and keep opening trades,
It's like using the market's money to add leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding is astonishing; once it stops, floating profits can go from
a gain of several dozen points to zero in just one or two big down candles.

【The mathematical truth】The essence of compounding positions is “getting it right repeatedly.” If the win rate is 60%, the odds of getting it right four times in a row
are only 13%. Behind every post you see about doubling your money overnight are 99 people who have already deleted their accounts.

title: 金字塔加仓：趋势单怎么越涨越加才不翻车
subTitle:
看对了趋势想加仓，怎么加？一上来就重仓+浮盈加满，是爆仓名单上的
常客。正确的做法叫金字塔加仓。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramid Scaling: How to Add to a Trend Trade as It Rises Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve correctly read the trend and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going in big right away and adding until you’re fully invested with unrealized profits is a recipe for landing on the liquidation list.
A common mistake. The right approach is called pyramid scaling.

【Principle】Each time you add to your position, add less than you did the time before. For example: start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
After another confirmation, add 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be. Keep most of your cost basis low so you can weather a pullback.

【Why the reverse is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more as the price rises) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses. Once you lose your nerve, every move goes wrong.

ETH staking rewards have become cash distributions | ETHE reports a $2.08 million November payment | I’d wait for a move above 1860 before considering a long

My stance is cautiously bullish, but I only count the distribution that has already happened; I wouldn’t portray it as new buying pressure tonight. Grayscale Ethereum Staking ETF (ETHE)’s latest quarterly report states that $2.0796 million was paid to shareholders on November 4, equal to $0.024556 per share and funded by staking rewards. November 3 was the ex-dividend and record date. Grayscale’s product page lists the same per-share amount and dates. The timing matters: the money has already been paid. What we’re seeing today is renewed confirmation that the mechanism is operating—not a newly announced dividend on November 15, and certainly not the fund buying $2.0796 million worth of ETH today.

Why is this worth watching? Staking rewards have traveled from on-chain ETH rewards, through deductions for validator and sponsor fees, to being sold for dollars and delivered as cash to ETF holders. This shows that the distribution process is now working in practice for traditional accounts holding ETH exposure. It could make ETH products more attractive to some institutions evaluating them. But converting rewards into dollars also means ETH is sold as part of the distribution process, so “staking distributions” cannot be equated directly with a net bullish effect on the token’s price. Fund subscriptions and redemptions, spot ETF flows, and price action need to be considered separately. Farside’s latest listed figure, for November 13, shows approximately $2.3 million in net inflows across the ETH spot ETF market—a small amount that is not enough on its own to establish that the flow trend has reversed.

The market reaction has not confirmed a clear direction either. At the time of writing, ETH/USD was around $1,829 on Kraken, with a 24-hour range of approximately $1,808 to $1,935, indicating that volatility remains high and pullbacks are still occurring during the rebound. Around $1,820 is where I’m watching to see whether short-term buyers can hold the line; $1,808 is the low already reached in the range. Above that, I’d look first at $1,860, then $1,900. These are trading reference levels, not price forecasts from the report. If the price falls below $1,808 and cannot recover quickly, or if ETFs see continued outflows, my short-term view that “improved yield mechanics support fund-flow expectations” would no longer hold.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t chase the price just because of the distribution news. I’d only consider a small spot long, initially allocating 5% of my total trading capital. I’d wait for ETH to move back above $1,860 and for at least two hourly candles to close above it, then enter only if a retest holds. If triggered, I’d first target $1,900 and sell half there; I’d look to gradually reduce the remaining position around $1,930. I’d place a stop below $1,820 after entry; if the price drops straight through $1,808, I’d cancel the plan. If, after entering, the price falls back below $1,860 and cannot recover it for two consecutive hours, or ETF flows and price action both weaken, I’d close the position proactively. Until all conditions are met, this is only a plan—not an executed trade, let alone a profitable one.

Sources: Grayscale ETHE product page, ETHE quarterly report filed with the U.S. SEC, Farside ETH ETF flow table, and publicly available Kraken market data. #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月十四日，以太坊现货报价一千八百五十二美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之五点二。价格从近期高点持续走低，先后跌破七日均线和二十五日均线，目前在布林带下轨附近运行。从小时级别K线来看，最近五根K线显示以太坊经历了一波快速下跌后在低位出现小幅反弹，最新报价一千八百四十三美元附近。以太坊在本轮调整中表现明显弱于比特币，价格已跌破一千八百五十美元关键支撑位，下方一千八百美元整数关口成为重要心理防线。从成交量来看，下跌过程中成交量放大，反弹时成交量萎缩，表明卖盘力量依然占据主导。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现明显的空头排列格局。七日均线位于一千八百五十七美元，二十五日均线位于一千九百零一美元，九十九日均线高居一千九百九十三美元，价格运行在所有主要均线下方，空头趋势确立。布林带下轨位于一千八百二十八美元，中轨位于一千八百九十一美元，上轨位于一千九百五十四美元，价格在中下轨之间运行，短期有测试下轨支撑的可能。MACD指标快线位于负二十六点九，慢线位于负二十二点一，柱状图为负四点八，空头动能仍在释放但略有收敛。RSI六周期从极度超卖的十一点六回升至二十九点七，仍处于弱势区域但已脱离最危险区间。KDJ指标K线位于二十七点六，D线位于三十点三，J线位于二十二点二，三线均在低位区域运行，尚未形成明确的金叉信号。威廉指标位于负七十点五，处于超卖区域。综合来看，以太坊技术面整体偏空，但超卖程度已较为严重，存在技术性修复的可能。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊面临的多重利空因素正在叠加发酵。首先，现货以太坊ETF持续遭遇赎回，十月至十一月期间累计流出超过十五亿美元，机构资金对以太坊的信心明显不足。其次，以太坊基金会近期出售了约七千五百枚以太坊换取稳定币，这一举动被市场解读为内部人士对短期价格缺乏信心，进一步打压了市场情绪。第三，Glamsterdam升级被推迟，Hoodi测试网也因智能合约兼容性问题延迟上线，这对以太坊的技术路线图信心造成了打击。从链上数据来看，交易所净流出在近期超过一亿美元，但主要是大户抛售主导，大单卖出占比高达百分之五十七。在因子统计方面，十五个因子中有九个发出空头信号，五个发出多头信号，综合指标指向做空，空头胜率为百分之七十六。不过值得注意的是，MegaETH虽然裁员百分之二十，但将资源转向AI产品开发，反映出以太坊生态正在探索新的增长方向。纽约证券交易所选择Avalanche进行代币化股票结算，也表明区块链技术在传统金融中的应用仍在推进。

The amount here is based on the position's notional value; it doesn't equal the actual loss. In isolated margin mode, when a position with 10x leverage is liquidated, the loss is roughly the margin—about one-tenth of the notional value.
The risk of leveraged trading is that even if you're ultimately right about the direction, a sudden price spike along the way can still liquidate your position early.
Indicators may be inaccurate, but risk management can't be absent: deciding in advance what to do if you're wrong matters more than guessing whether you'll be right.
